One Policy, Many Embodiments: Unified Camera-Centric Action Geometry Pre-training for Heterogeneous Embodied Manipulation VLA

Vision-Language-Action models unified action formulation heterogeneous embodied manipulation camera-centric geometry policy transfer

简要说明：UCAG-P提出了一种统一的以相机为中心的动作几何预训练框架，将异构具身数据集（机器人、人形机器人、人类）对齐到共享的几何动作空间，使得单一VLA策略能在不同形态间迁移操控技能，无需针对特定基准微调。

TLDR: UCAG-P proposes a unified camera-centric action geometry pre-training framework that aligns heterogeneous embodied datasets (robots, humanoids, humans) into a shared geometric action space, enabling a single VLA policy to transfer manipulation skills across embodiments without benchmark-specific fine-tuning.

Abstract: Scaling generalist vision-language-action (VLA) policies is severely bottlenecked by the inherent heterogeneity of embodied data, which spans diverse robot morphologies, camera configurations, and low-level action spaces. Existing paradigms typically address this mismatch through explicit action retargeting, human-to-robot video synthesis, or dataset-specific adaptation branches, fundamentally hindering the joint learning of a unified policy. We introduce UCAG-P, a camera-centric unified action formulation that structurally aligns heterogeneous embodied datasets into a shared geometric action space. Rather than treating robot-specific commands as the shared policy target, UCAG-P represents manipulation through camera-observable anchor motion in image and camera-frame coordinates, treating robot arms, humanoids, and human hands as different embodiments of a common action schema. A geometry-conditioned action translator combines predicted motion with target-embodiment kinematics to produce executable controls. The resulting decoupled architecture allows a shared VLA policy to learn transferable manipulation geometry while retaining embodiment-specific controllability. UCAG-P is trained on 4.03K hours of robot and simulation data and 2.34K hours of human demonstrations. A single checkpoint reaches 98.3% on LIBERO, 88.7% and 89.2% on RoboTwin Easy and Hard, 82.0% zero-shot on LIBERO-Plus, and 62.0% on RoboCasa GR-1, without benchmark-specific fine-tuning.

摘要（中文）：扩展通用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的能力受到具身数据固有异质性的严重制约，这些数据涵盖不同的机器人形态、相机配置和底层动作空间。现有范式通常通过显式动作重定向、人-机器人视频合成或数据集专用适配分支来解决这种不匹配问题，这从根本上阻碍了统一策略的联合学习。我们提出UCAG-P——一种以相机为中心的统—动作表示方法，它将异构具身数据集在结构上对齐到共享的几何动作空间。UCAG-P不将机器人专用指令作为共享策略目标，而是通过图像和相机坐标系中相机可观测的锚点运动来表示操作行为，将机械臂、人形机器人和人类手部视为共同动作模式的不同具身体现。一种几何条件动作翻译器将预测运动与目标具身运动学相结合，生成可执行的控制信号。由此产生的解耦架构允许共享的VLA策略学习可迁移的操作几何特性，同时保留特定具身的可控性。UCAG-P在4030小时的机器人与仿真数据以及2340小时的人类演示数据上进行了训练。无需针对基准测试进行微调，单个检查点在LIBERO上达到98.3%的准确率，在RoboTwin Easy和Hard任务上分别达到88.7%和89.2%，在LIBERO-Plus上实现82.0%的零样本性能，在RoboCasa GR-1上达到62.0%。

Authors: Xiaomi Embodied Intelligence Team, University of Macau, :, Shaoqing Xu, Fang Li, Guozhi Zhan, Zhixiang Duan, Yuhan Wang, Yuechen Luo, Shengyin Jiang, Hanbing Li, Zhiying Du, Longlong Wang, Longmei Jiang, Weixiang Liang, Ying Gong, Yong Pan, Ziping Zhao, Zhiyuan Chen, Yangwei You, Kun Ma, Qinyuan Liu, Hangjun Ye, Zhi-xin Yang

$R^3$: Training Robots to Reason in Natural Language via Reinforcement Learning VLA

robotic reasoning reinforcement learning vision-language-action long-horizon manipulation test-time compute

简要说明：本文提出了R^3，一种基于强化学习的后训练方法，使视觉语言模型生成自由形式的语言推理轨迹来指导底层机器人策略，从而在长时域操作任务中提升探索与泛化能力。

TLDR: This paper introduces R^3, a post-training method that uses reinforcement learning to train vision-language models to generate free-form language reasoning traces that guide low-level robotic policies, improving exploration and generalization on long-horizon manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Reasoning in language allows foundation models to spend more test-time compute on hard problems, such as those requiring decomposition, constraint tracking, and prediction of future consequences. Whether this mechanism can improve robotic manipulation remains unclear, where long-horizon tasks require tracking partial progress, reasoning about object relations, recovering from mistakes, and steering noisy low-level policies. In this paper, we study whether VLMs can be trained to reason directly in natural language to guide low-level manipulation policies. We introduce $R^3$, a simple post-training recipe that turns off-the-shelf VLMs into robotic reasoners: it first mid-trains a VLM on expert-generated reasoning traces to initialize the desired reasoning style, then improves the reasoner with single-step rubric-based RL from offline action data. Unlike prior robotic reasoning methods that mostly use structured traces as auxiliary supervision, $R^3$ trains free-form language reasoning to produce test-time guidance for action. We instantiate $R^3$ on Language Table and simulated bimanual grocery packing, two controlled testbeds for studying robotic reasoning and long-horizon manipulation. $R^3$ improves exploration and generalization across unseen tasks and significantly outperforms instruction-only imitation learning baselines on both benchmarks. Our analyses suggest that free-form language reasoning can function as a test-time compute mechanism for steering low-level policies. Our project page is available at https://robotic-reasoner.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：语言推理能力使得基础模型能够在处理需要分解、约束追踪及后果预测的难题时，投入更多测试时计算资源。然而，这一机制能否提升机器人操作能力仍不清楚——长时域任务需要跟踪局部进展、推理物体关系、从错误中恢复并引导含噪声的低层级策略。本文研究能否训练视觉语言模型直接通过自然语言推理来指导低层级操作策略。我们提出$R^3$这一简洁的后训练方案，可将现成视觉语言模型转化为机器人推理器：首先在专家生成的推理轨迹上对视觉语言模型进行中期训练以初始化所需推理风格，随后通过基于离线动作数据的单步准则强化学习优化推理器。不同于先前主要将结构化轨迹作为辅助监督的机器人推理方法，$R^3$训练自由形式语言推理以生成测试时动作指导。我们在Language Table平台和模拟双臂杂货打包任务——两个用于研究机器人推理与长时域操控的受控实验台——上实例化$R^3$。实验表明，$R^3$提升了未知任务的探索与泛化能力，在两个基准测试中显著超越仅依赖指令的模仿学习基线。我们的分析表明，自由形式语言推理可作为引导低层级策略的测试时计算机制。项目主页参见https://robotic-reasoner.github.io/。

Authors: Lehong Wu, Yuxiao Qu, Zheyuan Hu, Ivan Zhang, Limin Wei, Zackory Erickson, Aviral Kumar

LM-X: Explainable Action Modeling with Progress, Event, and Uncertainty Prediction for Generalist Robot Manipulation VLA

Vision-Language-Action model explainable action modeling return-to-go event-to-go heteroscedastic action flow

简要说明：LM-X 提出了一种带有显式多时间尺度预测信号（任务进度、事件边界、动作不确定性）的 VLA 模型，这些信号既用于控制又提供内在解释，在模拟和真实机器人任务上取得了大幅提升。

TLDR: LM-X introduces a VLA model with explicit multi-timescale predictive signals (return-to-go, event-to-go, heteroscedastic action flow) that serve both as control inputs and intrinsic explanations, achieving large gains on simulated and real robot tasks.

Abstract: Generalist vision--language--action (VLA) policies learn long-horizon behavior mainly through short-horizon action prediction and reveal little beyond sampled commands. This creates two coupled bottlenecks: a single action target must implicitly absorb task progress, intermediate intent, and local reliability, while these control states remain hidden during execution. Inspired by functional principles of biological sensorimotor control, we introduce LM-X , which organizes prediction across task, event, and motor scales without claiming anatomical correspondence. Three explicitly supervised signals are emitted online and directly condition action generation: return-to-go (RTG) measures visible task progress, event-to-go (ETG) identifies the next semantic transition, and heteroscedastic action flow estimates local reliability through propagated variance. Explanation is therefore intrinsic to control rather than generated post hoc. Before a costly 20-day pretraining run on 64 NVIDIA B200 GPUs, a controlled five-task pretraining gate verifies the design: the complete model improves success by 16.0 points over the action-only backbone and by 10.8 points over the strongest single-head variant. We then train LM-X on more than 20,000 hours of real-robot trajectories, including over 1,000 hours of failed policy rollouts. LM-X achieves 74.1\% across 50 randomized-hard RoboTwin2.0 tasks versus 55.4\% for GR00T N1.7, and 68.6\% versus 50.7\% across seven real-robot tasks. RTG tracks semantic progress and visible regression, while variance rises during hesitation and oscillatory control. These results show that explicit multi-timescale predictive state can strengthen control while exposing interpretable internal estimates.

摘要（中文）：通用型视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略主要通过短时域动作预测来学习长时域行为，且几乎不涉及采样指令之外的信息。这导致两个相互耦合的瓶颈：单一动作目标必须隐式地吸收任务进度、中间意图和局部可靠性，而这些控制状态在执行过程中始终保持隐藏状态。受生物感觉运动控制功能原理的启发，我们提出了LM-X框架，该框架在任务、事件和动作尺度上组织预测，但不声称具有解剖学对应关系。三个显式监督信号在线发出并直接调节动作生成：待完成回报量（RTG）衡量可见的任务进度，待完成事件量（ETG）标识下一个语义转换，异方差动作流通过传播方差估计局部可靠性。因此，解释性内嵌于控制过程本身，而非事后生成。在64块NVIDIA B200 GPU上启动耗时20天的预训练之前，我们通过一个受控的五任务预训练门控验证了设计方案：完整模型相比纯动作基线模型提升了16.0个百分点的成功率，相比最强的单头变体提升了10.8个百分点。随后，我们使用超过20,000小时的真实机器人轨迹（包括超过1,000小时的失败策略执行数据）训练LM-X。在50个随机硬化的RoboTwin2.0任务中，LM-X取得了74.1%的成功率，而GR00T N1.7为55.4%；在七个真实机器人任务中，LM-X取得68.6%的成功率，对比基线为50.7%。RTG能够追踪语义进程和可见的退化现象，而方差在犹豫和振荡控制期间升高。这些结果表明，显式的多时间尺度预测状态能够增强控制能力，同时提供可解释的内部估计。

Authors: Jin Lou, Zhiyuan Jing, Andong Chen, Xupeng Wang, Yuan Xu, Yuexuan Li, Xingdong Zhu, Zhijie Zhu, Yingwei Ji, Wenpeng Nie, Yufei Liu, Boyang Xing, Lei Jiang, Yan Cui, Ying Chu, Jingxuan Zhu, Jingyi Li, Liangliang Chen, Jinyan Liu, Zhiqi Song, Jidong Zhang, Hongming Li, Yuchen Zhu

SUPER ODOMETRY 2.0: Resilient Odometry via Hierarchical Adaptation Locomotion

sensor fusion adaptive odometry learning-based inertial odometry hierarchical adaptation all-degraded environments

简要说明：超级里程计2.0提出了一种分层传感器融合框架（自适应特征选择、状态方向选择、引擎选择以及基于学习的惯性里程计），使空中、轮式和腿式机器人在严重环境退化下实现稳健的里程计。

TLDR: Super Odometry 2.0 presents a hierarchical sensor fusion framework (adaptive feature selection, state direction, engine selection, and learning-based inertial odometry) that enables robust and resilient odometry for aerial, wheeled, and legged robots under severe environmental degradations.

Abstract: Resilient and robust odometry is crucial for autonomous systems operating in complex and dynamic environments. Existing odometry systems often struggle with severe sensory degradations and extreme conditions such as smoke, sandstorms, snow, or low-light conditions, threatening both the safety and functionality of robots. To address these challenges, we present Super Odometry, a sensor fusion framework that dynamically adapts to varying levels of environmental degradation. Super Odometry employs a hierarchical structure to integrate four core modules from lower-level to higher-level adaptability including adaptive feature selection, adaptive state direction selection, adaptive engine selection, and a novel learning- based inertial odometry. The inertial odometry, trained on over 100 hours of heterogeneous robotic platforms, captures comprehensive motion dynamics. Super Odometry elevates the inertial measurement unit (IMU) to equal importance with camera and LiDAR within the sensor fusion framework, providing a reliable fallback when exteroceptive sensors fail. Super Odometry has been validated across 200 kilometers and 800 operational hours on a fleet of aerial, wheeled, and legged robots, under diverse sensor configurations, environmental degradation, and aggressive motion profiles. It marks an important step towards safe and long-term robotic autonomy in all-degraded environments.

摘要（中文）：鲁棒且稳健的里程计对于在复杂动态环境中运行的自主系统至关重要。现有的里程计系统往往难以应对严重的传感器退化以及烟雾、沙尘暴、雪天或低光照等极端条件，这威胁到了机器人的安全性和功能性。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了Super Odometry——一种能够动态适应不同程度环境退化的传感器融合框架。Super Odometry采用层级结构，集成了从低到高四个核心适应性模块：自适应特征选择、自适应状态方向选择、自适应引擎选择，以及一种新颖的基于学习的惯性里程计。该惯性里程计在超过100小时的异构机器人平台数据上训练而成，能够捕捉全面的运动动态。Super Odometry将惯性测量单元（IMU）提升至与相机和激光雷达在传感器融合框架中同等重要的地位，在外感受传感器失效时提供可靠的备用方案。该框架已在空中、轮式和足式机器人群体上，历经200公里、800小时运行的验证，涵盖了多种传感器配置、环境退化条件及剧烈运动模式。这标志着在全面退化环境中迈向安全、长期机器人自主性的重要一步。

Authors: Shibo Zhao, Sifan Zhou, Yuchen Zhang, Ji Zhang, Chen Wang, Wenshan Wang, Sebastian Scherer

StreamPI: Streaming Multimodal Temporal Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

streaming temporal modeling vision-language-action models instruction-anchored attention random-interval training robot manipulation

简要说明：StreamPI提出了一种流式多模态时序建模框架，在不增加额外参数的情况下为单帧VLA模型赋予时序推理能力，通过指令锚定注意力和随机间隔训练提升真实机器人和仿真任务的表现。

TLDR: StreamPI introduces a streaming multimodal temporal modeling framework that equips single-frame VLA models with temporal reasoning without extra parameters, using instruction-anchored attention and random-interval training to improve performance on real-robot and simulation tasks.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated effectiveness in robot manipulation, yet state-of-the-art models such as pi0.5 operate under a single-frame paradigm, limiting their ability to retain past observations and develop precise spatial perception. In this paper, we propose StreamPI, a streaming multimodal temporal modeling framework that equips single-frame VLA with temporal reasoning capability without introducing any additional parameters. One core design is instruction-anchored temporal modeling. It treats each (visual observation, language instruction) pair as an atomic temporal unit: bidirectional attention within each pair enables cross-modal fusion, while causal attention across pairs preserves autoregressive streaming inference. This ensures the language instruction serves as a persistent semantic anchor throughout task execution. To bridge the gap between synchronous training and asynchronous real-robot deployment, we introduce a andom-interval streaming training strategy: a proper inter-frame interval (e.g., every 3 frames) enables faster and smoother action execution. Beyond this, randomizing the interval further improves robustness to frame-timing perturbations, supporting asynchronous deployment in practice. Furthermore, by leveraging the length extrapolation capability of the LLM backbone, StreamPI seamlessly inherits pretrained single-frame weights and supports flexible single-frame and multi-frame inference. Experiments on real-robot tasks spanning memory-dependent and precise perception scenarios, as well as the simulation benchmark LIBERO, demonstrate that StreamPI outperforms pi0.5 across diverse tasks.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中展现出有效性，然而诸如pi0.5等最先进模型仍运行于单帧范式下，限制了其保留历史观测和构建精确空间感知的能力。本文提出StreamPI——一种流式多模态时序建模框架，无需引入任何额外参数即可赋予单帧VLA时序推理能力。其核心设计之一是指令锚定时序建模：该方法将每个（视觉观测，语言指令）对视为一个原子时序单元——对内的双向注意力实现跨模态融合，对间的因果注意力则保持自回归流式推理。由此确保语言指令在任务执行全程作为持久语义锚点。为弥合同步训练与异步真实机器人部署之间的差距，我们引入随机间隔流式训练策略：适当的帧间间隔（例如每3帧）可实现更快更顺畅的动作执行。此外，随机化间隔进一步提升了针对帧时序扰动的鲁棒性，从而支持实际场景中的异步部署。更进一步，通过利用大语言模型骨干的长度外推能力，StreamPI无缝继承预训练单帧权重，并支持灵活的单帧与多帧推理。在涵盖记忆依赖与精确感知场景的真实机器人任务及仿真基准LIBERO上的实验表明，StreamPI在多种任务上均优于pi0.5。

Authors: Zhe Liu, Jinghua Hou, Yuxiang Lu, Zhenya Yang, Xianzhe Fan, Junwei Luo, Junyi Li, Ruihua Han, Zhi Hou, Hengshuang Zhao

Zero-WAM: In-Context World-Action Modeling from Human Videos for Open-Ended Task Generalization VLA

in-context learning video-action model human-robot ICL future chunk prediction cross-task generalization

简要说明：Zero-WAM 提出了一种因果视频-动作模型，通过从人类视频中学习上下文来实现机器人操作的零样本跨任务泛化，无需特定任务训练数据。

TLDR: Zero-WAM introduces a causal video-action model that leverages in-context learning from human videos to achieve zero-shot cross-task generalization in robotic manipulation, bypassing the need for task-specific training data.

Abstract: Zero-shot cross-task generalization, where a policy must execute manipulation tasks never seen during training, remains a central challenge in robot learning. In large language models, a novel task can be performed simply by specifying it in the context, without any parameter update. This form of in-context learning (ICL) turns generalization into a problem of task specification. To achieve cross-task generalization, we bring this paradigm to robotic manipulation, and argue that the natural task specification for manipulation is a human video: unlike language, it provides rich visual cues about the intended task evolution. We present Zero-WAM, a causal video-action model that executes unseen tasks by following in-context human video guidance. To address the scarcity of task-rich paired human-robot data, we propose an automatic pipeline that converts task-sampled robot trajectories into semantically matched human videos, yielding HumanGen, a dataset of 74.2K human-robot ICL pairs across 8.6K tasks. For model training, we further introduce an in-context future chunk prediction (IFP) objective that suppresses shortcuts learned from seen tasks and forces the policy to draw task information from the video prompt. On seven unseen tasks in RoboTwin 2.0 simulation, Zero-WAM achieves a 47.0% average success rate, an absolute improvement of 29.5 percentage points over the strongest video-action baseline. In real-world evaluations, it follows human video guidance to generalize to unseen task configurations involving multi-object scenes, long-horizon manipulation, and fine-grained insertion.

摘要（中文）：零样本跨任务泛化——即策略需执行训练过程中从未见过的操作任务——仍是机器人学习领域的核心挑战。在大语言模型中，仅需在上下文中指定任务描述即可执行新任务，无需任何参数更新。这种上下文学习（ICL）形式将泛化问题转化为任务规范问题。为实现跨任务泛化，我们将这一范式引入机器人操作领域，并论证操作任务的天然规范形式是人类视频：与语言不同，它能提供关于预期任务演进的丰富视觉线索。我们提出Zero-WAM，一种因果视频-动作模型，通过遵循上下文人类视频指导执行未见任务。为解决富含任务信息的配对人机数据稀缺问题，我们提出自动化流水线，将任务采样的机器人轨迹转化为语义匹配的人类视频，构建了包含8.6K个任务、74.2K对人机ICL样本的HumanGen数据集。在模型训练中，我们进一步提出上下文未来块预测（IFP）目标，抑制从已见任务中习得的捷径，迫使策略从视频提示中提取任务信息。在RoboTwin 2.0仿真环境的七项未见任务中，Zero-WAM达到47.0%的平均成功率，较最强视频-动作基线绝对提升29.5个百分点。在实际场景评估中，它能遵循人类视频指导泛化至未见任务配置，涉及多物体场景、长时域操作及精细插入操作。

Authors: Jiaming Zhou, Qihang Zhang, Gangwei Xu, Cunxin Fan, Yujie Zhao, Ruilin Wang, Yiming Luo, Shuai Yang, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Junwei Liang, Yinghao Xu

WALL-SS: Scaling Long-horizon World Models via Next-Scale Autoregression WorldModel

generative world models action-conditioned next-scale prediction scale-compressed long-horizon memory on-policy alignment long-horizon robotic simulation

简要说明：WALL-SS 提出了一种通过尺度自回归缩放生成动作可控、长时域视觉未来世界模型的方法，用于机器人仿真和规划。

TLDR: WALL-SS introduces a world model that uses scale-wise autoregressive scaling to generate action-controllable, long-horizon visual futures for robotic simulation and planning.

Abstract: Generative world models provide robots with predictive models of how the world evolves under interaction, with growing potential for simulation, planning, policy evaluation, and robot learning. Beyond clip-level future prediction, a unified generative formulation should relate actions to consequences, support flexible horizons and continuous interaction, and enable reward-driven optimization. We introduce WALL-SS, a world model that generates visual futures through Scale-wise autoregressive Scaling, enabling action-controllable and long-horizon robotic simulation. WALL-SS represents embodied trajectories as causal sequences of temporally interleaved observations and actions, making action-dependent state transitions explicit while naturally supporting variable-length generation, streaming extension through reusable causal states, and direct optimization through sequence probabilities. To make this formulation effective over long horizons, we generate each future observation in a coarse-to-fine manner and develop three complementary components within the same hierarchy. Action-conditioned next-scale prediction injects scale-aligned action representations to improve action-future coupling and model both successful and failed behaviors. Scale-compressed long-horizon memory retains recent interactions at fine resolution while compressing distant observations and actions, with scale-wise dream forcing enhancing robustness to self-generated context. Finally, on-policy alignment optimizes autoregressive visual dynamics with action-following and long-term consistency rewards while preserving the pretrained visual distribution. Experiments show that WALL-SS improves action following and trajectory accuracy, supports coherent minute-long streaming rollout under bounded memory, and consistently benefits from on-policy alignment in reducing action drift and long-horizon inconsistency.

摘要（中文）：生成式世界模型为机器人提供关于世界在交互作用下如何演化的预测模型，在仿真、规划、策略评估及机器人学习领域展现出日益增长的潜力。相较于片段级未来预测，统一的生成式框架应建立动作与结果之间的关联，支持灵活的时间跨度与连续交互，并能够实现奖励驱动的优化。我们提出WALL-SS，一种通过层级自回归缩放生成视觉未来的世界模型，从而实现动作可控的长时域机器人仿真。WALL-SS将具身轨迹表示为时间交错观测与动作的因果序列，显式建立动作依赖的状态转换关系，同时自然支持变长生成、通过可复用因果状态实现的流式扩展，以及基于序列概率的直接优化。为使该框架在长时域中有效运作，我们采用从粗到细的方式生成每个未来观测，并在同一层级结构中开发三个互补组件：动作条件化的下一尺度预测通过注入尺度对齐的动作表示来增强动作-未来耦合，并成功建模成功与失败行为；尺度压缩的长时域记忆在保留精细分辨率下近期交互的同时压缩远距离观测与动作，并通过层级梦境驱动增强对自生成上下文的鲁棒性；最后，在线策略对齐在保持预训练视觉分布的前提下，利用动作跟随与长期一致性奖励优化自回归视觉动态。实验表明，WALL-SS在动作跟随与轨迹精度上获得提升，支持有限记忆下的连贯分钟级流式展开，并持续从在线策略对齐中受益，有效减少动作漂移与长时域不一致性。

Authors: Maeve Zhang, Rain Sun, Xiang Wang, Cyril Zhang, Shalfun Li, Meng Cao, Howard Lu, Ethan Chen, Harry Jhou, KZ Zheng, Lights Shi, Regis Cheng, Lorenzin, Robert Wang, Victor Yao, Gody Li, Elise Mon, Yohann Tang, Ryan Yu, PS Zhang, Vincent Chen, Hang Su, Roy Gan, Hao Wang, Qian Wang

Fast Generative Grasping via Lie Group-Constrained MeanFlow Manipulation

generative grasping Lie group MeanFlow conditional flow matching fast inference

简要说明：提出了一种基于李群（SO(3) × ℝ³）上MeanFlow的快速生成式抓取方法，仅需≤5次网络评估即可生成可靠抓取，在ACRONYM数据集上相比扩散/流模型实现高达39倍加速，并可直接迁移到真实机器人抓取。

TLDR: A fast generative grasping method using MeanFlow on a Lie group (SO(3) x R^3) that achieves grasp synthesis in ≤5 network evaluations with 39x speedup over diffusion/flow baselines, demonstrated on the ACRONYM dataset and real-world robots.

Abstract: Grasp synthesis is a core task in robotic manipulation, for which the solution typically forms a multimodal distribution rather than a point estimate. Generative robotic grasping aims to learn this distribution with deep generative models such as diffusion and flow-based approaches. The iterative nature of such generative models makes them flexible and generalizable; however, multi-step sampling impedes the time-critical operation required in robotics. We devise an approach to fast generative grasping based on MeanFlow on the product Lie group $\mathcal{G} = \mathrm{SO}(3) \times \mathbb{R}^3$. The training objective couples a purely algebraic semigroup consistency condition with Riemannian Conditional Flow Matching on $\mathcal{G}$ that anchors the average velocity to the data distribution. The resulting Lie Group-constrained MeanFlow formulation samples reliable grasps in $\leq 5$ network evaluations, matching the grasp generation performance of state-of-the-art diffusion and flow-based models on the ACRONYM dataset at millisecond-scale inference latency (up to $39\times$ speed-up). We further demonstrate that the approach directly translates to real-world robotic grasping without additional training or domain adaptation, exhibiting robust grasp synthesis under observation noise.

摘要（中文）：抓取合成是机器人操作中的核心任务，其解通常呈现多模态分布而非点估计。生成式机器人抓取旨在通过深度生成模型（如扩散模型和基于流的方法）学习该分布。此类生成模型的迭代特性使其具备灵活性与泛化能力，然而多步采样过程阻碍了机器人技术所需的时间关键型操作。我们提出了一种基于乘积李群 $\mathcal{G} = \mathrm{SO}(3) \times \mathbb{R}^3$ 上平均流（MeanFlow）的快速生成式抓取方法。该训练目标将纯代数半群一致性条件与 $\mathcal{G}$ 上的黎曼条件流匹配相结合，将平均速度锚定至数据分布。由此产生的李群约束平均流公式能够在 $\leq 5$ 次网络评估内采样出可靠抓取，在毫秒级推理延迟下（加速比高达 $39\times$）达到与基于扩散和流的先进模型在 ACRONYM 数据集上相当的抓取生成性能。我们进一步证明，该方法无需额外训练或领域自适应即可直接迁移至真实世界机器人抓取场景，在观测噪声下展现出鲁棒的抓取合成能力。

Authors: S. Talha Bukhari, Yi Wei, Ruiqi Ni, Zachary Kingston, Aniket Bera

VISTA: Visually Inferred Spatial ConTact Attention for Contact-Rich Manipulation Manipulation

Visual Deformation Field contact-rich manipulation imitation learning visuo-physical feedback deformation-augmented policy

简要说明：VISTA-Policy 是一种模仿学习范式，利用柔性夹爪的视觉变形场 (VDF) 作为高维度视觉-物理反馈，无需专用触觉传感器即可实现精确的接触式操作。

TLDR: VISTA-Policy is an imitation learning paradigm that uses a Visual Deformation Field (VDF) from a compliant gripper as high-dimensional visuo-physical feedback, enabling precise contact-rich manipulation without dedicated tactile sensors.

Abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires precise interaction feedback. While vision-centric imitation learning is prevalent, external visual observations provide indirect and ambiguous cues about contact states, particularly under occlusion or subtle object--gripper interactions; dedicated tactile or force sensors can provide rich contact information but introduce additional hardware complexity, calibration requirements, and deployment costs. To bridge this gap, we propose VISTA-Policy, an imitation learning paradigm that utilizes the Visual Deformation Field (VDF), a 3D displacement representation of a compliant gripper, as high-dimensional visuo-physical feedback. The framework integrates: 1) a Physics-Aware Encoding Engine for real-time VDF decoding; 2) an Energy Aggregation Denoising Mechanism to isolate true interaction signals; and 3) a Deformation-Augmented Policy Network with incremental gripper actions for precise closed-loop correction. Extensive evaluations on Cross-Scale Object Grasping, Cap Unscrewing, and Calligraphy Writing demonstrate that VISTA-Policy outperforms the strong pure-vision baseline 3D Diffusion Policy and the tactile baseline. VISTA-Policy further demonstrates substantial out-of-distribution generalization to unseen object scales and robustness against dynamic disturbances, offering a durable and cost-effective route toward general-purpose fine-grained manipulation in unstructured environments. Project videos and supplementary materials are available at: https://sites.google.com/view/vista-policy.

摘要（中文）：接触丰富的操作需要精确的交互反馈。尽管以视觉为中心的模仿学习十分普遍，但外部视觉观察提供的接触状态信息是间接且模糊的，尤其是在存在遮挡或物体-夹爪间细微交互的情况下；专用的触觉或力传感器能够提供丰富的接触信息，但会引入额外的硬件复杂度、标定要求及部署成本。为解决这一困境，我们提出了VISTA-Policy，一种模仿学习范式，它利用视觉变形场（VDF）——一种柔性夹爪的三维位移表示——作为高维视觉-物理反馈。该框架集成了：1）用于实时VDF解码的物理感知编码引擎；2）用于分离真实交互信号的能量聚合去噪机制；以及3）采用增量夹爪动作以实现精确闭环修正的变形增强策略网络。在跨尺度物体抓取、瓶盖旋开及书法书写任务上的大量评估表明，VISTA-Policy优于强纯视觉基线3D扩散策略及触觉基线方法。VISTA-Policy还展现了对未见物体尺度的显著分布外泛化能力以及在动态扰动下的鲁棒性，为在非结构化环境中实现通用细粒度操作提供了一条耐用且经济高效的路径。项目视频与补充资料请访问：https://sites.google.com/view/vista-policy。

Authors: Jiayi Chen, Wenlong Dong, Yan Huang, Xianglin Chen, Zijian Lin, Jiaqi Yin, Yushan Liu, Wenbo Ding

MA-VLA: Multi-Arm Vision-Language-Action Model for Collaboration and Compositional Generalization VLA

multi-arm collaboration atomic action assignment Arm Shuffle compositional generalization vision-language-action models

简要说明：MA-VLA 是一种多臂 VLA 框架，通过每个手臂的原子动作分配和训练时的排列方法（Arm Shuffle），在仿真和真实任务中实现对未见多臂协作模式的组合泛化。

TLDR: MA-VLA is a multi-arm VLA framework that uses per-arm atomic action assignment and a training-time permutation method (Arm Shuffle) to achieve compositional generalization to unseen multi-arm collaboration patterns in simulation and real-world tasks.

Abstract: Multi-arm collaboration is becoming a core capability in embodied manipulation. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models integrate perception, language, and control, but most represent language as a single global instruction and do not provide an explicit mechanism for assigning and composing arm-specific behaviors. This design limits transfer to collaboration patterns that differ from those observed during training. We present MA-VLA, a unified framework for multi-arm collaboration via atomic action assignment. MA-VLA decomposes cooperative behavior into mid-level atomic prompts and allocates them to individual arms, enabling explicit subgoal specification and compositional reuse across tasks. To reduce reliance on fixed execution roles, we introduce Arm Shuffle, a training-time permutation of the observation, state, and assigned atomic prompts for each arm. This permutation enforces role-agnostic instruction following and supports recomposition into unseen coordination patterns, which we term multi-arm compositional generalization. We also construct a benchmark in which test-time collaboration patterns are absent in training set. Across simulation and real-world evaluations, prior state-of-the-art VLAs largely fail under these unseen collaborations, while MA-VLA consistently succeeds. These results indicate that structured, per-arm atomic action assignment offers a practical route to scalable generalization in multi-arm embodied systems. Code, models, and data are available at https://github.com/zhangzaibin/future-robots

摘要（中文）：多臂协作正成为具身操作中的核心能力。当前的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型整合了感知、语言与控制，但大多将语言表示为单一的全局指令，且未提供明确的机制来分配和组合各机械臂的特定行为。这种设计限制了模型向与训练期间观察到的协作模式不同的场景进行迁移。我们提出MA-VLA，一种通过原子动作分配实现多臂协作的统一框架。MA-VLA将协作行为分解为中层原子化提示，并将其分配给各个机械臂，从而支持明确的子目标指定及跨任务的组合复用。为减少对固定执行角色的依赖，我们引入"臂序重排"（Arm Shuffle）技术，即在训练时对每只机械臂的观测、状态及分配的原子化提示进行排列置换。这种强制要求无角色依赖的指令遵循能力，并支持将行为重组为未见过的协调模式——我们称之为多臂组合泛化。我们还构建了一个测试集中不存在训练时协作模式的基准数据集。在仿真与真实世界评估中，现有最先进的VLA模型在这些未见过的协作场景下基本失效，而MA-VLA始终成功。这些结果表明，结构化的、逐臂原子动作分配为多臂具身系统中的可扩展泛化提供了实用路径。代码、模型与数据已开源：https://github.com/zhangzaibin/future-robots。

Authors: Zaibin Zhang, Junlan Xiao, Zhongbo Zhang, Yifan Wang, Li Kang, Yiran Qin, Changxing Xia, Heng Zhou, Talas Fu, Enshen Zhou, Ruimao Zhang, Zhenfei Yin, Huchuan Lu, Lijun Wang

TacForcing: Streaming Action Generation with Execution-Time Tactile Feedback Manipulation

streaming action generation tactile feedback vision-language-action model contact-rich manipulation execution-time conditioning

简要说明：TacForcing 提出了一个流式动作生成框架，将执行时的触觉反馈集成到视觉-语言-动作模型中，用于接触丰富的操作任务，成功率高于基线方法。

TLDR: TacForcing introduces a streaming action generation framework that integrates execution-time tactile feedback into vision-language-action models for contact-rich manipulation, achieving higher success rates than baselines.

Abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires adapting to contact states that can evolve substantially within an action horizon. However, chunk-based vision-language-action models predict complete action chunks from observations collected before execution, leaving tactile conditioning stale during execution. Existing tactile-reactive approaches typically rely on separate high-frequency controllers, which increase both architectural and training complexity. In this paper, we introduce TacForcing, a streaming action-generation framework that effectively incorporates execution-time tactile feedback. Instead of employing a separate reactive controller, TacForcing replaces the standard action expert with a streaming action expert to generate actions conditioned on the evolving tactile observations acquired during execution. TacForcing also introduces Execution-Aware Tactile Attention (EATA), which restricts tactile conditioning to actions nearing execution, thereby reducing the temporal mismatch between tactile acquisition and action execution. Across six simulated UniVTAC tasks and three real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, TacForcing achieves average success rates of 65% and 69%, respectively, outperforming strong baselines in both settings.

摘要（中文）：接触丰富的操作需要适应动作周期内可能显著演变的接触状态。然而，基于分块的视觉-语言-动作模型仅根据执行前采集的观测结果预测完整的动作块，导致执行过程中触觉条件失效。现有的触觉响应方法通常依赖独立的高频控制器，这增加了架构和训练的复杂性。在本文中，我们提出TacForcing，一种有效整合执行时触觉反馈的流式动作生成框架。TacForcing无需采用独立的响应控制器，而是用流式动作专家替代标准动作专家，根据执行过程中不断演变的触觉观测生成动作。同时，TacForcing引入了执行感知触觉注意力（EATA），将触觉条件限制在即将执行的动作上，从而减少触觉采集与动作执行之间的时间错位。在六个模拟UniVTAC任务和三个真实世界的接触丰富操作任务中，TacForcing分别达到了65%和69%的平均成功率，在两个场景下均超越了强基线模型。

Authors: Jianbo Zhou, Boyuan Zhao, Yuzheng Zhang, Yiyang Chen, Wenxin Chen, Qiuyue Li, Xiangyang Gu, Yuhan Cao, Xiao Xia, Yanzhe Hu, Zhijie Deng

GaussianDream++: Efficient 3D Gaussian World Modeling for Robotic Manipulation VLA

3D Gaussian world modeling world state tokens world prediction tokens robotic manipulation efficient closed-loop control

简要说明：GaussianDream++ 在VLA骨干中插入世界状态和预测标记，通过高斯基元提供3D几何监督，并在推理时移除辅助解码实现高效的闭环机器人操作。

TLDR: GaussianDream++ inserts World State and Prediction Tokens into a VLA backbone to provide 3D geometric supervision via Gaussian primitives, then removes the auxiliary decoding at inference for efficient closed-loop robotic manipulation.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have advanced language-conditioned robotic manipulation, yet action-imitation objectives provide only weak supervision for metric 3D structure and short-horizon physical evolution. Geometry-enhanced policies mainly improve current-scene grounding, whereas predictive policies often model future dynamics in RGB or latent spaces and may incur substantial deployment cost. GaussianDream demonstrates that training-time current Gaussian reconstruction and future Gaussian prediction provide effective 3D supervision, but its dense VGGT/TGE-based prefix jointly carries state, dynamics, and action-conditioning information. We present \textbf{\methodname}, a compact, policy-native extension that inserts \textbf{World State Tokens} and \textbf{World Prediction Tokens} directly into the VLA backbone. A training-only \textbf{World Representation Head} decodes these tokens into a Current World and coupled Future Prediction over shared Gaussian primitives, while static--dynamic factorization preserves persistent structure and focuses residual motion on interaction-relevant regions. At inference, the head, renderer, auxiliary objectives, and VGGT/TGE pathway are removed, leaving only 20 world tokens without online Gaussian decoding or rollout. \method achieves \textbf{98.6\%} on LIBERO and \textbf{87.8\%} on LIBERO-Plus, with clear gains under Camera and Layout shifts. Real-robot experiments further improve average success from 29.2\% to 52.5\% over reproduced $π_{0.5}$ while maintaining efficient closed-loop control.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略推动了语言条件机器人操作的发展，然而动作模仿目标对度量三维结构和短时域物理演化的监督信号较弱。几何增强策略主要改善当前场景的 grounding，而预测策略通常在 RGB 或潜在空间中对未来动态进行建模，并可能带来高昂的部署成本。GaussianDream 表明，训练时的当前高斯重建与未来高斯预测能够提供有效的三维监督，但其基于密集 VGGT/TGE 的前缀联合携带了状态、动力学和动作条件信息。我们提出 \textbf{\methodname}，一种紧凑的、策略原生的扩展方法，将 \textbf{世界状态令牌} 和 \textbf{世界预测令牌} 直接插入 VLA 骨干网络。仅用于训练的 \textbf{世界表征头} 将这些令牌解码为当前世界和在共享高斯基元上的耦合未来预测，同时通过静态-动态分解保留持久结构，并将残差运动聚焦于交互相关区域。在推理阶段，我们将表征头、渲染器、辅助目标以及 VGGT/TGE 通路全部移除，仅保留 20 个世界令牌，无需在线高斯解码或 rollout。\method 在 LIBERO 上达到 \textbf{98.6\%}，在 LIBERO-Plus 上达到 \textbf{87.8\%}，并在相机视角与布局变化下取得明显提升。真实机器人实验进一步将平均成功率从复现的 $π_{0.5}$ 的 29.2\% 提升至 52.5\%，同时保持了高效的闭环控制。

Authors: Yuqing Jiang, Zijian Zhang, Weitao Zhou, Jiawei Wang, Junjie He, Lei Yang, Haifang Qing, Si Liu, Ding Zhao, Ping Luo, Haibao Yu

Leveraging Inter-object Affordances for Efficient Planning in Contact-rich Tasks Manipulation

task-and-motion planning inter-object affordances Vision-Language Model contact-rich manipulation U-TAMP

简要说明：本文提出U-TAMP，一种利用视觉语言模型生成物体间可供性抽象的任务与运动规划方法，用于接触丰富的操作任务，相比基线方法实现了更高的成功率和更快的规划速度。

TLDR: This paper introduces U-TAMP, a task-and-motion planning approach that uses a Vision-Language Model to generate abstractions of inter-object affordances for contact-rich manipulation, achieving higher success rates and faster planning compared to baselines.

Abstract: Traditional task-and-motion planning (TAMP) approaches primarily focus on defining sequences of actions along with the necessary geometric and kinematic constraints to execute long-horizon tasks. However, their applicability in real-world settings is limited, as they typically assume simplified object models that overlook key physical properties critical for the successful execution of contact-rich tasks. Moreover, they often use sub-symbolic reasoning during motion planning, which drastically increases planning time and decreases overall success rates. We propose a method that leverages a TAMP approach, defining object-centric abstractions of execution constraints, called Unified TAMP (U-TAMP), to execute robotic tasks involving interactions among objects with heterogeneous shapes, sizes, and materials. Using a Vision-Language Model (VLM), we generate abstractions of inter-object affordances for characterizing physical interaction constraints between objects in contact-rich tasks, such as grasp and support constraints. These constraints are used to enrich the U-TAMP planning domain to deal with objects with variable physical properties. We perform experiments in simulated kitchen table organization scenarios and compare our results with those of the original U-TAMP, as well as a state-of-the-art VLM-based planner that leverages common sense knowledge of objects' affordances for plan generation. Our approach achieves significantly higher planning success rates and improves planning times by one to two orders of magnitude compared to other methods.

摘要（中文）：传统的任务与运动规划（TAMP）方法主要侧重于定义动作序列以及执行长时域任务所需的几何和运动学约束。然而，它们在真实场景中的适用性有限，因为这些方法通常假设简化的物体模型，忽略了对于成功执行接触密集型任务至关重要的关键物理属性。此外，这些方法在运动规划过程中常采用亚符号推理，这大幅增加了规划时间并降低了整体成功率。我们提出了一种基于TAMP的方法，定义了以物体为中心的执行约束抽象，称为统一TAMP（U-TAMP），用于执行涉及具有异质形状、尺寸和材质的物体间相互作用的机器人任务。利用视觉语言模型（VLM），我们生成物体间可供性的抽象，以表征接触密集型任务中物体之间的物理交互约束，例如抓取和支撑约束。这些约束被用于丰富U-TAMP规划域，以处理具有可变物理属性的物体。我们在模拟厨房台面组织场景中进行了实验，并将我们的结果与原始U-TAMP以及一种基于VLM的最先进规划器进行了比较，后者利用物体可供性的常识知识进行计划生成。与其他方法相比，我们的方法实现了显著更高的规划成功率，并将规划时间提升了一到两个数量级。

Authors: Pouya P. Niaz, Justus Piater, Alejandro Agostini

RA-VLA: Retrieval-Augmented VLA for Test-Time Adaptation VLA

retrieval-augmented vision-language-action test-time adaptation in-context imitation learning robotic manipulation

简要说明：RA-VLA 提出了一种检索增强的 VLA 框架，通过行为对齐的上下文检索来提升机器人操作中的测试时适应能力和推理效率。

TLDR: RA-VLA introduces a retrieval-augmented VLA framework with behavior-aligned context retrieval to improve test-time adaptation and inference efficiency for robotic manipulation.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a versatile foundation for general robotic manipulation, yet they exhibit significant brittleness when confronted with novel task distributions. While In-Context Imitation Learning (ICIL) offers a training-free alternative, existing frameworks suffer from an adaptation bottleneck that hinders the effective translation of expert context to executable actions. This failure originates from superficial retrieval mechanisms and an inherent behavioral inertia that anchors the policy to its pre-trained priors. To address these limitations, we present RA-VLA, a retrieval-augmented VLA framework that integrates behavior-aligned context retrieval with a grounded execution pipeline. By enforcing faithful adherence to functional cues within a scalable architecture, RA-VLA facilitates seamless task adaptation while preserving inference efficiency. Our empirical evaluations across the LIBERO benchmark and a real-world UR5e environment demonstrate that RA-VLA achieves superior success rates and computational efficiency, establishing a robust framework for training-free robotic adaptation.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型为通用机器人操作提供了多功能基础，但在面对新颖任务分布时表现出显著的脆弱性。尽管上下文模仿学习（ICIL）提供了一种无需训练的替代方案，但现有框架存在适应瓶颈，阻碍了将专家上下文有效转化为可执行动作。这一失败源于浅层的检索机制以及一种固有的行为惯性——该惯性将策略锚定在其预训练先验上。为解决这些局限，我们提出RA-VLA，一种检索增强型VLA框架，将行为对齐的上下文检索与具身化执行流程相结合。通过在可扩展架构中强制忠实遵循功能线索，RA-VLA在保持推理效率的同时实现无缝任务适应。我们在LIBERO基准测试和真实UR5e环境中的实证评估表明，RA-VLA在成功率和计算效率上均表现卓越，为无需训练的机器人适应建立了稳健框架。

Authors: Sanghwan Jang, Minjin Jeon, Minsoo Kim, Seongjin Choi, Dongha Kim, Hwanjo Yu

ConfAL-WM: Confidence-Guided Active Learning for Action-Conditioned World Models WorldModel

action-conditioned world models confidence-guided active learning embodied world models dense confidence maps RoboTwin2.0

简要说明：本文提出ConfAL-WM，一种基于置信度引导的主动学习框架，用于对具身世界模型进行后训练，通过在UNet解码器特征上附加轻量级置信度探针实现高效数据选择与局部训练增强，在RoboTwin2.0上得到验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes ConfAL-WM, a confidence-guided active learning framework for post-training embodied world models, using a lightweight confidence probe on UNet decoder features to enable efficient data selection and localized training enhancement, validated on RoboTwin2.0.

Abstract: Action-conditioned world models have become an important foundation for embodied prediction, planning, and synthetic data generation, but their errors under new task and scene distributions are often concentrated in localized spatiotemporal regions such as robot arms, manipulated objects, contact areas, and occluded objects. This paper presents ConfAL-WM, a confidence-guided active learning framework for post-training embodied world models. Built upon EVAC, we attach a lightweight confidence probe to UNet decoder features and predict dense confidence maps in the latent space. These maps are aggregated into task-, frame-, and patch-level scores, enabling both efficient data selection and localized training enhancement. Our pipeline first retrains the confidence probe and warms up EVAC with a small subset of target-domain data, then performs task-level prescreening to allocate sampling budgets, and finally applies selected-data retraining with optional frame or patch weighted data enhancement. Experiments on RoboTwin2.0 show that confidence-guided selection improves post-training efficiency, while dense frame and patch weighting further enhances prediction quality and embodied trajectory consistency compared with scalar reward, progress, and judge-based scoring baselines. A quick visual overview of this work is available at https://ConfAL-WM.github.io.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 基于动作条件的世界模型已成为具身预测、规划及合成数据生成的重要基础，但在面对新任务与场景分布时，其误差往往集中于局部的时空区域，例如机器人手臂、操作对象、接触区域及被遮挡物体。本文提出ConfAL-WM，一种基于置信度引导的主动学习框架，用于具身世界模型的后训练。该方法基于EVAC，在UNet解码器特征上附加轻量级置信度探测模块，并在潜在空间中预测密集置信度图。这些置信度图被聚合为任务级、帧级及块级得分，从而实现高效的数据选择与局部训练增强。我们的流程首先重新训练置信度探测模块，并利用少量目标域数据对EVAC进行预热；随后执行任务级预筛选以分配采样预算；最后通过可选帧加权或块加权的数据增强策略，对所选数据进行再训练。在RoboTwin2.0上的实验表明，与基于标量奖励、进度及评判得分的基线方法相比，置信度引导的选择策略提升了后训练效率，而密集的帧与块加权进一步改善了预测质量及具身轨迹一致性。本研究的快速可视化概览可参见 https://ConfAL-WM.github.io。

Authors: Xiang Liu, Sen Cui, Changshui Zhang

LAC: Linear and Angular Compliance for Humanoid Whole-body Control HumanoidEmbodied

whole-body control linear compliance angular compliance teacher-student RL humanoid robot

简要说明：本文提出了一种人形机器人全身控制器，在外力作用下同时实现线性和角度顺应性，并通过师生强化学习跟踪顺应运动。

TLDR: This paper presents a whole-body controller for humanoid robots that achieves both linear and angular compliance under external wrenches, using teacher-student reinforcement learning to track compliant motions.

Abstract: Real-world humanoid tasks involve physical interaction with objects and humans, yet current controllers either reject external forces as disturbances or restrict compliance to limited body links while ignoring angular effects. We present LAC, a general whole-body controller that simultaneously realizes commanded Linear and Angular Compliance for wrenches applied to the upper body. First, we synthesize whole-body compliant responses into a large-scale augmented dataset. Sampled force and couple events are imposed on contact frames extracted from human interaction data. At each contact link, the external force and a virtual torque from the passively yielding kinematic chain drive a virtual admittance under the commanded stiffness. Subsequently, teacher-student reinforcement learning trains a single policy to track the compliant motions under external wrenches. Finally, extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate whole-body compliant responses to wrenches across the upper body, monotonic modulation over the full range of both stiffness commands, and applicability to teleoperated loco-manipulation tasks. Project website: https://lac-humanoid.github.io/

摘要（中文）：真实世界中的人形机器人任务涉及与物体和人类的物理交互，然而现有控制器要么将外力作为干扰加以拒绝，要么将柔顺性限制在有限的肢体连杆上且忽略角度效应。我们提出LAC，一种通用全身控制器，可同步实现针对上肢所受力螺旋指令的线性与角度柔顺性。首先，我们将全身柔顺响应综合为大规模增强数据集。基于从人类交互数据中提取的接触框架，在接触框架上施加采样的力与力偶事件。在每个接触连杆处，外力与来自被动屈服运动链的虚拟扭矩在指令刚度下驱动虚拟导纳。随后，通过师生强化学习训练单一策略，使其在外力螺旋作用下跟踪柔顺运动。最终，大量仿真与真实世界实验证明了：全身对上肢体螺旋的柔顺响应、两种刚度指令全范围内的单调调节能力，以及在遥操作移动操作任务中的适用性。项目网站：https://lac-humanoid.github.io/

Authors: Yang Liu, Zhongkai Gu, Wei Zhu, Mitsuhiro Hayashibe

RAEM: Robust Autonomous Exploration for Multi-Floor Environments with a Quadruped Robot Locomotion

quadruped robot autonomous exploration multi-floor navigation traversability representation staircase alignment

简要说明：RAEM提出了一种混合局部-全局可通行性表示方法，用于四足机器人在多层环境中进行鲁棒且计算高效的自主探索，并在仿真和真实实验中验证。

TLDR: RAEM proposes a hybrid local-global traversability representation for robust and computationally efficient autonomous exploration of multi-floor environments using a quadruped robot, validated in both simulation and real-world experiments.

Abstract: In this paper, we propose RAEM, a robust autonomous exploration framework for quadruped robots operating in multi-floor environments. Most existing ground-robot exploration approaches rely on planar traversability representations, which cannot adequately represent the overlapping structures and cross-floor connectivity of multi-floor buildings. Although tomography-based representations provide effective traversability modeling for multi-floor navigation, maintaining a global tomography map incurs substantial computational overhead for online exploration with frequent replanning. Moreover, sparse and fragmented LiDAR observations in stairwells can degrade local traversability estimation, leading to irregular viewpoint placement and temporary topological disconnections. To address these challenges, RAEM adopts a hybrid local-global traversability representation, in which a local tomography map and an explicitly categorized local 3D grid map are used for online terrain analysis and connectivity evaluation, while an elevation-aware global topological graph is incrementally constructed from these local spatial representations for efficient cross-floor exploration planning. We further introduce a staircase center alignment strategy to reduce abrupt yaw variations during climbing and a dual path searching mechanism to recover guidance paths when the global topology is locally disconnected. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate robust and computationally stable autonomous exploration across multi-floor structures, including continuous exploration of a five-floor stairwell.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了RAEM，一种适用于四足机器人在多层环境中运行的鲁棒自主探索框架。现有的大多数地面机器人探索方法依赖于平面可通行性表征，无法充分表示多层建筑中的重叠结构与跨楼层连通性。尽管基于断层扫描的表征方法为多层导航提供了有效的可通行性建模，但维护全局断层扫描地图会给需要频繁重规划的在线探索带来巨大的计算开销。此外，楼梯间中稀疏且碎片化的激光雷达观测会降低局部可通行性估计质量，导致视点放置不规则及临时拓扑断连。为应对这些挑战，RAEM采用了一种混合局部-全局可通行性表征方法：利用局部断层扫描地图与显式分类的局部三维栅格地图进行在线地形分析与连通性评估，同时从这些局部空间表征中增量构建高程感知的全局拓扑图，以实现高效的跨楼层探索规划。我们进一步引入了楼梯中心对齐策略以减少攀爬过程中的剧烈偏航变化，以及双路径搜索机制以在全局拓扑局部断连时恢复引导路径。大量仿真与真实实验证明，该方法在多层结构（包括五层楼梯间的连续探索）中实现了鲁棒且计算稳定的自主探索。

Authors: Zikang Yuan, Yuan Ren, Yian Wang, Yixue Wang, Enze Fang, Xuewei Zhang, Junda Cheng, Chi Chen, Chin-Pang Ho, Lijun Zhu, Shaohang Xu, Kwang-Ting Cheng, Xin Yang

Generative Action-Chunk Sampling for Adaptive Stiffness Control in Physical Human-Robot Collaboration Manipulation

adaptive stiffness control generative action-chunk sampling physical human-robot collaboration compliant control action variation

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于生成式动作块采样的自适应刚度控制框架，通过采样动作块之间的差异来持续调整机器人关节刚度，平衡物理人机协作中的辅助与顺从。

TLDR: This paper presents an adaptive stiffness control framework for physical human-robot collaboration that uses the variation among sampled action chunks from a generative policy to continuously adjust joint stiffness, balancing assistance and compliance.

Abstract: Physical human-robot collaboration requires a robot to provide assistance when human intention is clear while remaining compliant when several future motions are plausible. We present an adaptive stiffness framework based on generative action-chunk sampling. Conditioned on an RGB image and external joint-torque estimates, the policy samples multiple future action chunks from an observation-conditioned prior. Variation among the sampled action chunks is used to continuously adapt joint stiffness and damping. Greater variation makes the robot more compliant to facilitate human guidance, whereas lower variation provides firmer assistance. In a real-world collaborative transport task with four possible directions, the proposed method achieved an average success rate of 0.95, compared with 0.83 for a fixed-stiffness ablation and 0.69 for a deterministic baseline. Near direction determination, variation among the sampled action chunks increased and the controller accordingly reduced stiffness. These results suggest that variation among actions sampled by a generative policy can serve as an online control signal for balancing assistance and compliance in physical human-robot interaction.

摘要（中文）：物理人机协作要求机器人在人类意图明确时提供协助，而在多种未来动作皆有可能时保持柔顺。我们提出了一种基于生成式动作片段采样的自适应刚度框架。该策略以RGB图像和外部关节力矩估计为条件，从基于观测的先验分布中采样多个未来动作片段。通过采样动作片段间的差异性，持续调节关节刚度与阻尼：差异性较大时，机器人更加柔顺以辅助人类引导；差异性较小时，则提供更坚定的协助。在具有四种可能方向的真实世界协作搬运任务中，所提方法实现了0.95的平均成功率，而固定刚度消融实验为0.83，确定性基线为0.69。在接近方向判定阶段，采样动作片段的差异性增大，控制器相应降低刚度。这些结果表明，生成式策略所采动作片段的差异性能作为在线控制信号，用于平衡物理人机交互中的协助与柔顺性。

Authors: Aoi Otake, Ferdinand Hartmann, Ko Igari, Shingo Murata

Sequential Object Placement Optimization with Convex Decomposition Manipulation

sequential optimization convex decomposition differentiable nonlinear optimization bin packing robotic packing

简要说明：SOPO-CD 将顺序物体放置问题建模为分解自由空间上的可微非线性优化，在毫秒级实现最优放置，相比网格搜索加速100倍，并在真实世界中用机械手和机械臂解决了七巧板拼图。

TLDR: SOPO-CD frames sequential object placement as a differentiable nonlinear optimization in decomposed free space, achieving millisecond-level optimal placement with 100× speedup over grid search, and demonstrates real-world Tangram puzzle solving with a robotic hand and arm.

Abstract: Robotic object packing has been a core challenge for robotic deployment in logistics, industry, etc., due to the curse of dimensionality in combinatorial search and the difficulty of dealing with dynamic and contact constraints for irregularly shaped objects. Current heuristic and learning-based methods assume a limited spatial discretization resolution of space, and computation becomes extremely inefficient as discretization accuracy increases. In this work, we eliminate these assumptions by introducing SOPO-CD, a sequential optimization framework that frames object placement as a differentiable nonlinear optimization problem in a decomposed free space. We prove that placing a convex object inside a convex hull is essentially constraining the vertices of the object inside the convex hull. The constraints and their derivatives can be written in closed form and calculated within $200$ns. We implement a custom solver that achieves optimal placement within tightly constrained space in milliseconds; a $100 \times$ speedup compared to a classical grid search method. We generalize our framework to 2D Tangram, 2D Tetris, and 3D Bin Packing, and have demonstrated strong computational performance and packing utility. We also demonstrate solving a real-world Tangram puzzle online using an Allegro Hand and an Xarm.

摘要（中文）：机器人物体打包一直是物流、工业等领域机器人部署的核心挑战，原因在于组合搜索的维度灾难以及处理不规则形状物体时动态与接触约束的困难。当前基于启发式和机器学习的方法假设空间具有有限的空间离散化分辨率，且随着离散化精度的提升，计算效率会变得极低。在本工作中，我们通过引入SOPO-CD这一序列优化框架消除了这些假设——该框架将物体放置问题转化为分解自由空间中的可微非线性优化问题。我们证明：将凸物体放置在凸包内本质上等同于将物体的顶点约束在凸包内部。这些约束及其导数可写成闭式表达式，并在200纳秒内完成计算。我们实现了一个定制求解器，能够在毫秒级时间内实现紧密约束空间内的最优放置；与经典网格搜索方法相比实现了100倍的加速。我们将该框架推广到二维七巧板、二维俄罗斯方块和三维装箱问题，并展示了强大的计算性能与包装效用。我们还演示了使用Allegro灵巧手与Xarm机械臂在线解决真实七巧板谜题的过程。

Authors: Yuezhe Zhang, Xiangyu Lyu, Sohan Rudra, Davide Tateo, Georgia Chalvatzaki

SkyDrive: Learning to Drive in a New City from Aerial Traffic Monitoring AutonomousDriving

aerial traffic monitoring domain adaptation trajectory planner zero-shot transfer data scaling

简要说明：SkyDrive 提出利用无人机空中交通监控作为可扩展且高效的数据源，来将自动驾驶轨迹规划器适应到新城市，并证明有限的空中监督（例如每个位置30分钟）可以显著缓解跨城市领域的差距。

TLDR: SkyDrive proposes using drone-based aerial traffic monitoring as a scalable and efficient data source to adapt autonomous driving trajectory planners to new cities, demonstrating that limited aerial supervision (e.g., 30 minutes per location) can significantly mitigate cross-city domain gaps.

Abstract: Autonomous driving has made remarkable progress through imitation learning with massive human demonstration data. However, a trained planner often degrades severely when applied to a new environment zero-shot, because of domain shifts in traffic regulations, road layout and driving behaviors. Therefore, adapting a trajectory planner to a new city typically requires resource-demanding local data collection with a vehicle sensor suite. In this work, we show that driving behavior can be learned from a scalable and efficient alternative. We introduce \emph{SkyDrive}, a framework that utilizes drone-based traffic monitoring to provide efficient supervision for autonomous driving agents in a new environment. While vehicle-based data collection logs the ego and its surroundings, an aerial platform naturally observes many road users simultaneously over an extended field of view. As a result, every vehicle can be a data source with grounded driving behavior, effectively scaling up the amount of supervision. Based on 137 hours of aerial traffic monitoring footage, we extract 650K driving samples and construct a benchmark for trajectory planners and motion predictors. Zero-shot experiments with multiple models reveal significant cross-city domain gaps, but many of them can be alleviated by limited supervision from the sky, e.g., 30 minutes of monitoring per location. Our findings show that aerial traffic monitoring is an efficient and scalable data source for adapting autonomous driving systems in new cities. Data and code will be made publicly available.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 自动驾驶通过利用海量人类示范数据进行模仿学习取得了显著进展。然而，当训练好的规划器零样本应用于新环境时，由于交通法规、道路布局和驾驶行为的领域偏移，其性能往往会严重下降。因此，将轨迹规划器适配到新城市通常需要利用车载传感器套件进行资源密集型的本地数据采集。在本工作中，我们证明驾驶行为可以通过一种可扩展且高效的替代方案来学习。我们提出*SkyDrive*框架，该框架利用基于无人机的交通监控为新环境中的自动驾驶智能体提供高效监督。车辆数据采集记录自车及其周围环境，而空中平台则能自然地同时观测广阔视野内的多个道路使用者。由此，每辆车均可成为蕴含真实驾驶行为的数据源，有效扩大了监督数据的规模。基于137小时的空中交通监控视频，我们提取了65万个驾驶样本，并为轨迹规划器和运动预测器构建了一个基准。多模型零样本实验揭示了显著的跨城市领域差异，但其中许多差异可通过有限的空中监督（例如每个地点30分钟监控）得到缓解。我们的研究结果表明，空中交通监控是为自动驾驶系统适配新城市的一种高效且可扩展的数据来源。数据和代码将公开提供。

Authors: Weijiang Xiong, Lan Feng, Alexandre Alahi, Nikolas Geroliminis

V-Link: Recovering Lost Visual Representations in Action DiT for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

Vision-Language-Action Action DiT spatial queries semantic queries robotic manipulation

简要说明：V-Link通过在VLM中学习空间和语义查询，并将其注入动作DiT，恢复VLA模型中丢失的视觉表示，从而提升多项基准和真实人形机器人上的操控成功率。

TLDR: V-Link recovers lost visual representations in VLA models by injecting spatial and semantic queries from the VLM into the Action DiT, improving manipulation success rates on several benchmarks and a real humanoid robot.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide a scalable path toward generalist robotic manipulation by integrating visual perception, language understanding, and continuous action control. However, we reveal a critical limitation of VLA architectures: the action expert has limited access to the 3D geometric and 2D semantic information available in VLM features. This accessibility gap weakens perceptual grounding and limits performance on fine-grained robotic manipulation. To address this issue, we propose V-Link, which explicitly recovers visual representations during the vision-language (VL) to action (A) feature transfer. Specifically, V-Link learns complementary Spatial and Semantic Query representations within the VLM and injects them into Action DiT through asymmetric pathways. Semantic Queries complement the original VLM image tokens, whereas Spatial Queries provide dedicated geometric conditioning for spatially grounded action generation. Across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0, our V-Link improves the average success rate over base model GR00T N1.6 by +1.9%, +31.2%, and +18.8%, respectively. On the AGIBOT A3 Ultra, V-Link further achieves gains of +20% and +24% on two real-world humanoid tasks.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过整合视觉感知、语言理解与连续动作控制，为通用机器人操作提供了一条可扩展的路径。然而，我们揭示了VLA架构的一个关键局限性：动作专家对VLM特征中可用的3D几何与2D语义信息的访问能力有限。这一可访问性差距削弱了感知基础，并限制了精细机器人操作的性能。为解决该问题，我们提出V-Link，该方法在视觉-语言（VL）到动作（A）的特征传递过程中显式恢复视觉表征。具体而言，V-Link在VLM内部学习互补的空间与语义查询表征，并通过非对称路径将其注入Action DiT。语义查询补全了原始VLM图像标记，而空间查询则为基于空间的动作生成提供了专门的几何条件约束。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus与RoboTwin 2.0上，我们的V-Link相较于基础模型GR00T N1.6的平均成功率分别提升了+1.9%、+31.2%与+18.8%。在AGIBOT A3 Ultra上，V-Link进一步在两项真实世界人形机器人任务中分别取得了+20%与+24%的提升。

Authors: Yehao Lu, Jiarui Yang, Yuning Su, Yufeng Xie, Yu Zhong, Yazhou Zhang, Haiyu Lan, Kaixiang Lu, Peiwen Lin, Chuang Wang, Zequn Qin, Enyu Li, Xi Li

Gating Before Commitment: Anticipating Intent Divergence to Prevent Post-Interaction Decision Failures in Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

intent divergence gating mechanism language-guided autonomous driving planning failures

简要说明：本文提出了一种语言引导的门控机制，用于自动驾驶，在交互前预测意图分歧并提前门控规划动作，从而避免交互后的决策失败。

TLDR: This paper introduces a language-guided gating mechanism for autonomous driving that anticipates intent divergence between vehicles and gates maneuvers before commitment, preventing post-interaction failures.

Abstract: Intent misinterpretation during vehicle interactions causes recurring planning failures. We study a decision layer in which a language-guided intent module reads structured descriptors, computes a smoothed intent-geometry divergence score, and gates the planned maneuver before commitment, upstream of a corridor envelope. On a replayed off-road departure and four crash clips under a frozen, disclosed implementation, gating is the only layer that repairs the plan: on the main case it fires 72 ms after the drift onset but 161 ms before the corridor exit, keeping the trajectory in the corridor in all ten replays. The first calibration draws nine false triggers in 5.9 minutes, each from scoring uncertainty as half a conflict; a preregistered redesign treating uncertainty as abstention cuts this to 0.341 per minute. Two ablations bound the model's contribution: the full score detects fastest on four of five failures under the deployed eligibility, three of five against the unvetoed rule (000871 by one cycle; 000228 by a pre-onset fire on an uncertain stretch that five clips cannot classify as signal or coincidence; dropping the confidence term costs two detections), while on in-domain tracks at equal false positives the geometric rule more than triples its detection. The evidence supports the gating mechanism; the model's demonstrated roles are the fastest detection on these failures and an uncertainty veto on the geometric rule.

摘要（中文）：车辆交互过程中的意图误判会导致规划失败反复出现。本文研究了一种决策层，其中语言引导的意图模块读取结构化描述符，计算平滑的意图-几何发散度分数，并在执行前对规划机动进行门控，该门控位于通道包络的上游。在冻结、公开的实现条件下，通过对一次越野偏离重播和四段碰撞剪辑进行测试，门控是唯一能够修正规划的层级：在主案例中，该机制在漂移开始后72毫秒触发，但在通道出口前161毫秒触发，使得所有十次重播中的轨迹均保持在通道内。首次标定在5.9分钟内产生九次误触发，每次均由将评分不确定性视为半次冲突所致；一项预先注册的重新设计将不确定性视为弃权，将误触发率降至每分钟0.341次。两项消融实验界定了模型的贡献：在部署合格条件下，完整分数在五次失败中检测到四次最快，在非否决规则下检测到三次最快（其中一次因一个周期内编号000871；另一次因不确定路段上预触发编号000228，五段剪辑无法将其归类为信号或巧合；丢弃置信度项则损失两次检测），而在同等误报率的域内轨迹上，几何规则的检测率提高了三倍以上。证据支持门控机制的有效性；该模型展现的作用包括在失败案例中实现最快检测，以及对几何规则进行不确定性否决。

Authors: Cong Xu, Ravi Sankar

DESCENT: Directed Edge Scene Encoding for Airport Surface Movement Prediction AutonomousDriving

motion forecasting airport surface movement transformer potential reachable set trajectory prediction

简要说明：DESCENT 是一种基于变压器的机场场面运动预测架构，通过潜在可达集采样机制和检测变压器解码器处理异构动力学和拓扑约束，在 Amelia-10 基准上显著优于基线。

TLDR: DESCENT is a transformer-based architecture for airport surface movement prediction that uses a Potential Reachable Set sampling mechanism and detection transformer decoder to handle heterogeneous dynamics and topological constraints, significantly outperforming baselines on the Amelia-10 benchmark.

Abstract: Advanced automation is a key technology for enhancing the safety of ground operations amidst the increasing density of commercial air traffic. While motion forecasting is a well-studied task in autonomous driving, its application to airport surface movements remains underexplored. To enable efficient and accurate prediction in this domain, we propose DESCENT, a transformer-based architecture designed to handle heterogeneous dynamics and strict topological constraints. Our approach features a Potential Reachable Set (PRS) context sampling mechanism that adaptively collects airfield environment context across diverse operational phases. Combined with a detection transformer-based decoder, DESCENT generates accurate trajectory forecasts. Extensive evaluations on the Amelia-10 benchmark demonstrate significant performance improvements over state-of-the-art baselines. These gains are especially pronounced in safety-critical scenarios, where our domain-aware sampling provides critical long-horizon context necessary for safe navigation.

摘要（中文）：先进自动化是提升地面运行安全性的关键技术，以应对日益密集的商业空中交通。尽管运动预测在自动驾驶领域已得到充分研究，但其在机场场面运动中的应用仍鲜有探索。为实现该领域高效精准的预测，我们提出DESCENT——一种基于Transformer的架构，旨在处理异构动力学特性与严格的拓扑约束。该方法的核心在于采用潜在可达集（PRS）上下文采样机制，该机制能够自适应地收集不同运行阶段的机场环境上下文信息。结合基于检测Transformer的解码器，DESCENT可生成精确的轨迹预测。在Amelia-10基准上的广泛评估表明，与现有最优基线相比，该方法在性能上取得了显著提升。这种优势在安全关键场景中尤为突出——我们的领域感知采样为安全导航提供了必要的长时域上下文信息。

Authors: Alexander Prutsch, David Schinagl, Horst Possegger

Choose Your Game Wisely: Measuring Game-Theoretic Structures in Real-World Vehicle Interactions AutonomousDriving

game-theoretic models vehicle interactions trajectory measurement temporal structure real-world driving datasets

简要说明：本文开发了一个基于轨迹的测量框架，利用六个真实驾驶数据集实证分析车辆交互中的时间结构（同时、顺序、不对称），发现不同博弈论模型是互补而非普适的交互抽象。

TLDR: This paper develops a trajectory-based measurement framework to empirically analyze temporal interaction structures (simultaneous, sequential, asymmetric) in real-world vehicle interactions, using six driving datasets, and finds that different game-theoretic formulations are complementary modeling abstractions rather than universal structures.

Abstract: Game-theoretic models provide principled frameworks for modeling vehicle interactions, but their underlying temporal assumptions have not been systematically examined against real-world driving behavior. In particular, it remains unclear how simultaneous, sequential, and asymmetric interaction structures can be measured from vehicle trajectories. This paper develops a trajectory-based interaction measurement framework to identify interaction events and quantify behavioral change onset, temporal organization, post-onset response dynamics, and ordering stability. The framework uses behavioral deviations to verify candidate interactions. We evaluate the framework on six real-world trajectory datasets, including INTERACTION, highD, inD, rounD, Waymo Open Motion, and nuPlan, covering diverse road geometries, traffic environments, and interaction types. The results show that concurrent and sequential behavioral changes both constitute substantial proportions of observed following, merging, and conflicting interactions. Among sequential interactions, stable ordering is more prevalent than alternating ordering, indicating that persistent asymmetric roles are a common interaction structure. Importantly, temporal precedence does not necessarily coincide with a measurable behavioral response, indicating that temporal ordering alone may not be sufficient to characterize behavioral dependence. These findings show that real-world interactions exhibit concurrent, sequential, and persistently ordered temporal structures. Different game-theoretic formulations are therefore better regarded as complementary modeling abstractions for different interaction regimes rather than as a universal structure governing all vehicle interactions.

摘要（中文）：博弈论模型为车辆交互建模提供了原则性框架，但其潜在的时间假设尚未基于真实驾驶行为进行系统性检验。尤其需要明确的是，如何从车辆轨迹中量化同时性、序贯性和非对称性交互结构。本文构建了一套基于轨迹的交互行为度量框架，用于识别交互事件，并量化行为变化起始点、时间组织模式、起始后响应动态及顺序稳定性。该框架利用行为偏差对候选交互进行验证。我们基于六个真实轨迹数据集（包括INTERACTION、highD、inD、rounD、Waymo Open Motion及nuPlan）评估该框架，这些数据集涵盖了多样化道路几何形态、交通环境及交互类型。结果表明：同步与序贯行为变化在观测到的跟驰、汇入及冲突交互中均占据显著比例。在序贯交互中，稳定顺序比交替顺序更为普遍，表明持续性非对称角色是常见交互结构。值得注意的是，时间先后顺序并不必然伴随可量化的行为响应，这意味着单凭时间顺序可能不足以刻画行为依赖性。这些发现表明，真实交互呈现同步、序贯及持续有序的时间结构。因此，不同博弈论建模方式应被视为针对不同交互模式的互补性建模抽象，而非支配所有车辆交互的普适性结构。

Authors: Yueyuan Li, Rongcheng Nie, Weijie Xi, Mingyang Jiang, Songan Zhang, Hanyang Zhuang, Ming Yang

AGRO-Nav: Autonomous Graph-based Orchard Navigation AutonomousDriving

global planning topological graph orchard navigation autonomous driving path smoothing

简要说明：AGRO-Nav 从果园 SLAM 点云中构建稀疏拓扑图，无需人工航点即可规划居中路径，在真实和模拟果园中实现了比 A* 和 Theta* 基线更低的横向误差和更快的规划速度。

TLDR: AGRO-Nav builds a sparse topological graph from orchard SLAM point clouds to plan row-centered global paths without manual waypoints, achieving lower lateral error and faster planning than A* and Theta* baselines in real and simulated orchards.

Abstract: Orchards form semi-structured environments in which parallel tree rows create natural driving corridors, yet narrow inter-row clearance and dense foliage lead geometry-agnostic grid planners to drift off the row center and risk trunk or canopy contact. We present AGRO-Nav, an automated framework for static graph-based global planning in orchards. From tree-row lines fitted to trunk clusters in a SLAM point cloud, it builds, without any manual waypoints, a sparse topological graph of intra- and inter-row connectivity; a global route is then found by Dijkstra search on this graph, connected to the start and goal by any-angle Theta* segments, and smoothed with a cubic B-spline. In real-orchard trials, AGRO-Nav follows the row center with a mean error of about 0.08 m, far below the A* (0.31 m) and Theta* (0.43 m) shortest-path baselines, while planning roughly four to five times faster. In Isaac Sim, it attains the lowest error among A*, Theta*, and a reproduced RANSAC midline baseline and remains stable as tree density drops to 70%, where the RANSAC baseline degrades. The resulting trajectories---straight row-centered segments joined by controlled turns---suit differential-drive and four-wheel-steering platforms.

摘要（中文）：果园构成了半结构化环境，其中平行的果树行自然形成了可行驶通道，然而狭窄的行间间隙与茂密的枝叶会导致忽略几何结构的栅格规划器偏离行中心，并面临树干或树冠接触风险。本文提出AGRO-Nav，一种基于静态图进行果园全局路径规划的自动化框架。通过将SLAM点云中的树干聚类拟合为果树行线，该框架无需任何人工航点即可构建包含行内与行间连通性的稀疏拓扑图；随后在图上通过Dijkstra搜索获取全局路径，路径两端以任意角度Theta*算法连接起点与终点，并采用三次B样条曲线进行平滑处理。在实际果园试验中，AGRO-Nav跟踪行中心的平均误差约为0.08 m，远低于A*（0.31 m）和Theta*（0.43 m）的最短路径基线，同时规划速度提升约4至5倍。在Isaac Sim中，该算法在A*、Theta*及复现的RANSAC中线基线中误差最低，且当树木密度降至70%（此时RANSAC基线性能下降）时仍保持稳定。生成的轨迹——由受控转弯连接的行中心直线段构成——适用于差速驱动与四轮转向平台。

Authors: Ho Young Yun, Jaemin Yu, Duksu Kim

PRISM: Projection-Integrated Sampling-Based MPC with Bayesian Cost Tuning for Bimanual Manipulation Manipulation

sampling-based MPC bimanual manipulation world model QP-guided sampling Bayesian optimization

简要说明：PRISM 是一个投影集成采样模型预测控制框架，利用 GPU 加速物理模拟器作为在线世界模型进行双臂操作，采用 QP 引导的采样策略和贝叶斯代价调优。

TLDR: PRISM is a projection-integrated sampling-based MPC framework that uses a GPU-accelerated physics simulator as an online world model for bimanual manipulation, with a QP-guided sampling strategy and Bayesian cost tuning.

Abstract: Bimanual manipulation in cluttered, contact-rich environments remains challenging because it requires coordinated motion generation, interaction-aware planning, and reliable execution under tight kinematic constraints. We present PRISM, a projection-integrated sampling-based Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework that uses a GPU-accelerated physics simulator as an online world model for complex dual-arm manipulation. The main algorithmic contribution is a QP-guided control sampling strategy that decouples trajectory exploration from kinematic feasibility. At each MPC step, sampled joint-velocity trajectories are projected onto the set of motions satisfying joint position, velocity, acceleration, and jerk bounds, together with an initial-velocity boundary condition, before rollout evaluation. This enables broad yet feasible exploration of coordinated bimanual behaviors. To support efficient online execution, we derive a custom ADMM/Bregman-splitting QP solver that exploits joint-wise separability and reusable matrix factorizations. We further use Bayesian optimization to tune task-cost weights offline, reducing manual parameter selection. We evaluate PRISM on challenging variants of PerAct$^{2}$ tasks, including obstacle-constrained ball transport, tray transport, cube handover, and box lifting. Experiments show improved robustness and task success relative to representative sampling-based baselines, while maintaining real-time or near-real-time execution. We also demonstrate successful sim-to-real transfer on dual UR5e manipulators, highlighting the practical potential of physics-based online planning for contact-rich bimanual manipulation. Project details, including code and supplementary videos, are available at \href{https://sites.google.com/view/prismbimanual}{\texttt{https://sites.google.com/view/prismbimanual}}.

摘要（中文）：在复杂、高接触的杂乱环境中进行双臂操作仍然具有挑战性，这需要协调的运动生成、交互感知规划以及在严苛运动学约束下的可靠执行。我们提出PRISM，一种基于投影与集成采样的模型预测控制（MPC）框架，该框架利用GPU加速的物理仿真器作为在线世界模型，用于复杂的双臂操作任务。 本文的主要算法贡献在于提出了一种QP引导的控制采样策略，该策略将轨迹探索与运动学可行性解耦。在每一步MPC中，采样的关节速度轨迹在滚动评估之前，会被投影到满足关节位置、速度、加速度和加加速度约束以及初始速度边界条件的运动集合上。这使得双臂协调行为的探索既广泛又可行。为支持高效的在线执行，我们推导了一个自定义的ADMM/布雷格曼分裂QP求解器，该求解器利用了关节间的可分离性和可复用的矩阵分解。此外，我们使用贝叶斯优化离线调整任务成本权重，从而减少手动参数选择。 我们在具有挑战性的PerAct²任务变体上评估了PRISM，包括障碍约束下的球体运输、托盘运输、立方体交接和箱子抬升。实验表明，与代表性的基于采样的基线方法相比，所提方法在鲁棒性和任务成功率上均有提升，同时保持了实时或近实时执行。我们还在双UR5e机械臂上成功实现了从仿真到现实的迁移，突显了基于物理的在线规划在高接触双臂操作中的实际潜力。项目详情，包括代码和补充视频，可在 \href{https://sites.google.com/view/prismbimanual}{\texttt{https://sites.google.com/view/prismbimanual}} 获取。

Authors: Alinjar Dan, Iryna Hurova, Karl Kruusamäe, Arun Kumar Singh

EgoNav: Bridging Learned Waypoints and Geometry-Aware Local Control for Robust Indoor Navigation VLN

image-goal navigation hierarchical navigation waypoint refinement adaptive local planner humanoid robot

简要说明：EgoNav 提出了一种分层室内导航系统，通过几何约束和自适应局部路径规划优化学习航点，在真实人形机器人上提升了成功率和路径效率。

TLDR: EgoNav presents a hierarchical indoor navigation system that refines learned waypoints using geometric constraints and adaptive local path planning, demonstrating improved success rate and path efficiency on a real humanoid robot.

Abstract: Image-goal navigation using lightweight topological maps is a practical paradigm for indoor robot deployment: the map requires only geotagged images, and localization relies on visual matching rather than precise pose estimation. However, learned waypoint predictors can produce targets that violate geometric constraints or deviate from the global path. Executing these waypoints safely further requires a local planner capable of collision avoidance, yet existing systems either lack one or rely on fixed parameters that cannot adapt to confined spaces. To address these limitations while retaining the navigational intuition of the learned predictor, we present EgoNav, a hierarchical system that implements this idea by generating candidates from semantically segmented traversable regions and scoring them alongside the learned waypoint for geometric safety, directional coherence, and fidelity to the learned prior. An adaptive local path planner then executes the refined waypoint with parameters modulated based on the refinement outcome. Experiments in Habitat-sim and on a physical humanoid robot show that EgoNav consistently outperforms contemporary baselines in both success rate and path efficiency.

摘要（中文）：基于轻量化拓扑地图的图像目标导航是室内机器人部署的一种实用范式：该地图仅需地理标记图像，定位依赖视觉匹配而非精确位姿估计。然而，学习型航路点预测器可能生成违反几何约束或偏离全局路径的目标。安全执行这些航路点进一步需要具备避障能力的局部规划器，但现有系统要么缺乏此类规划器，要么依赖无法适应狭窄空间的固定参数。为在保留学习型预测器导航直觉的同时解决上述局限，我们提出层级式系统EgoNav，其通过从语义分割的可通行区域生成候选点，并基于几何安全性、方向一致性和对学习先验的忠实度对候选点与学习型航路点进行联合评分来实现该理念。随后，自适应局部路径规划器根据优化结果调节参数，执行优化后的航路点。在Habitat-sim仿真平台及实体人形机器人上的实验表明，EgoNav在成功率与路径效率两方面均持续优于当代基线方法。

Authors: Jing Wang, Shiqi Zhao, Hairong Qu, Peng Yin

A Tendon-Driven Five-Fingered Hand with Distributed Tactile Perception for Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

tendon-driven hand soft-rigid hybrid distributed tactile perception dexterous manipulation humanoid robot

简要说明：本文提出了一种新型的腱驱动五指灵巧手，采用刚柔混合结构并分布双模态触觉传感器，通过灵巧操作实验验证了系统的可行性。

TLDR: This paper presents a novel tendon-driven five-fingered robotic hand with a soft-rigid hybrid structure and distributed dual-modality tactile sensors, validated through dexterous manipulation experiments.

Abstract: To apply the techniques of embodied artificial intelligence to human-oid robots for complex manipulations, dexterous robotic hands are indispensable, which are restricted by the dexterity and tactile perception capability. In this work, we proposed a novel design of tendon-driven five-fingered hand with dis-tributed tactile perception. With a soft-rigid-hybrid structure employed, both compliance and operational force are endowed to the hand. Dual-modality tactile sensing elements are distributed on the distal and middle phalanges of all five fingers, enabling the simultaneous detection of static contact and dynamic force variations. Manipulation experiments, including counting gestures, finger-to-thumb pinching, object grasping, and bottle-grasp tactile recording, demonstrate the feasibility of the integrated actuation-perception system.

摘要（中文）：将具身人工智能技术应用于人形机器人以完成复杂操作时，灵巧机械手不可或缺，但其性能受限于灵巧度和触觉感知能力。本研究提出了一种采用分布式触觉感知的新型腱驱动五指手设计。通过刚柔混合结构，该手兼具柔顺性与操作力。五指远节指骨和中节指骨上分布了双模态触觉传感元件，可同步检测静态接触与动态力变化。通过计数手势、拇指对捏、物体抓取及抓瓶触觉记录等操作实验，验证了该驱动-感知集成系统的可行性。

Authors: Huayang Chen, Longhui Qin

Beyond Pairwise Feedback: Listwise Vision-Language Supervision for Preference-Based Reward Learning RLRobot

preference-based reward learning Plackett-Luce model vision-language models listwise ranking robotic manipulation

简要说明：本文首次提出将VLM生成的列表式偏好与Plackett-Luce模型结合用于奖励学习，并在Meta-World操作任务上展示了有效的机器人策略训练。

TLDR: This paper introduces the first framework combining VLM-generated listwise preferences with the Plackett-Luce model for reward learning, demonstrating effective robotic policy training on Meta-World manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as a powerful source of supervision for reinforcement learning, enabling agents to leverage rich semantic knowledge during training. Inspired by the success of preference-based reward learning (PbRL) in reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), vision-language model generated image-based preferences provide an effective source for learning reward functions. This can be done by visually comparing two outcomes through the Bradley-Terry (BT) model. However, this pairwise formulation utilizes only two observations at a time, despite VLMs being capable of ranking multiple candidates. The Plackett-Luce (PL) formulation can shape a reward model with listwise rankings as opposed to pairwise preferences, allowing for a more suited use of a VLM based ranking. In this work, to our knowledge, we introduce the first framework that combines VLM-generated preferences with the Plackett-Luce model for reward learning. We evaluate our approach on Meta-World manipulation tasks and show that Plackett-Luce (PL) reward models can train robotic policies from VLM-generated rankings as effectively as pairwise Bradley-Terry, $K$-wise Bradley-Terry, and RL-VLM-F baselines. Across all environments, at least one PL ranking size ($K \in \{3,4,5\}$) consistently performs with or outperforms other methods in mean success rate. Unlike pairwise methods, which are restricted to $K=2$, PL supports different ranking sizes and can therefore be adapted to the environment and desired feedback format. Our best PL configuration achieves an 86% mean final success rate and matches the Oracle baseline on Drawer Open. Overall, these results demonstrate that listwise VLM preference supervision is a competitive and flexible approach to reward learning for reinforcement learning.

摘要（中文）：视觉语言模型（VLMs）已成为强化学习中强大的监督来源，使智能体能够在训练过程中利用丰富的语义知识。受基于偏好的奖励学习（PbRL）在基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）中取得成功的启发，视觉语言模型生成的基于图像的偏好为学习奖励函数提供了有效来源。这可以通过布拉德利-特里（BT）模型对两个结果进行视觉比较来实现。然而，这种成对公式每次仅利用两个观测值，尽管VLM能够对多个候选方案进行排序。普莱克特-卢斯（PL）公式能够通过列表排序而非成对偏好来构建奖励模型，从而更充分地利用基于VLM的排序。在本工作中，据我们所知，我们首次提出了一个将VLM生成的偏好与普莱克特-卢斯模型相结合的奖励学习框架。我们在Meta-World操作任务上评估了我们的方法，并表明普莱克特-卢斯（PL）奖励模型能够像成对布拉德利-特里、K元布拉德利-特里以及RL-VLM-F基线一样有效地从VLM生成的排序中训练机器人策略。在所有环境中，至少有一种PL排序规模（K ∈ {3,4,5}）在平均成功率上持续表现优于或等同于其他方法。与局限于K=2的成对方法不同，PL支持不同的排序规模，因此可适应不同环境及所需反馈格式。我们最佳的PL配置实现了86%的平均最终成功率，并在Drawer Open任务上达到了Oracle基线的水平。总体而言，这些结果表明，列表式VLM偏好监督是强化学习中一种具有竞争力且灵活的奖励学习方法。

Authors: Srivalli Katkuri, Maxwell Kawada, Juan Wachs

PhaseShift: Topology-Aware Data Harmonization and Model Consolidation Across Signalized Intersections AutonomousDriving

topology-aware actor-centric representation trajectory prediction zero-shot transfer low-data adaptation

简要说明：PhaseShift将异构的路边轨迹统一为共享表示，从而训练单个可复用的交通行为模型，在多个信号交叉口上实现零样本迁移和低数据适应，并在长时程轨迹预测中优于局部模型。

TLDR: PhaseShift harmonizes heterogeneous roadside trajectories into a shared representation for training a single reusable traffic-behavior model across multiple signalized intersections, demonstrating zero-shot transfer and low-data adaptation that outperform local models in long-horizon trajectory prediction.

Abstract: Learned traffic-behavior models are commonly trained separately for each intersection, creating model portfolios that cannot share evidence across sites. We present PhaseShift, a topology-aware framework that harmonizes heterogeneous roadside trajectories into a shared actor-centric representation and trains one reusable backbone. Ego-relative coordinates, trajectory-induced movement paths, normalized signal context, and variable-cardinality interaction tokens remove site conventions while preserving behaviorally relevant topology. The backbone supports pooled operation, zero-shot at a held-out intersection, and low-data adaptation. We evaluate five intersections in two Florida regions on balanced field data, 100k training windows and equal-sized test sets per site under a replay-conditioned, best-of-sampled-trajectory protocol. At 10s, one pooled model lowers both minADE and minFDE relative to trained local models at all five sites, with median reductions of 36.8% and 22.0%. Leave-one-intersection-out deployment, including one cross-region fold, beats local training on both 10-s metrics at four of five sites, although short-horizon performance is less uniform. Fine-tuning with 1,000 target update windows improves on zero-shot at three sites and is the strongest regime at one. At site 7, every cross-site mixture sharply lowers long-horizon error under a fixed 100k-window budget; test-likelihood gains argue against a best-of-sample dispersion-only explanation. Local models fall behind calibrated IDM at the two highest-flow sites after long autoregressive rollouts; pretrained-backbone regimes do not. Within this five-site evaluation, PhaseShift demonstrates consolidation across heterogeneous physical control settings while identifying sites that still require adaptation. The protocol measures conditional single-vehicle generation under replayed context, not closed-loop traffic simulation.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 习得性交通行为模型通常针对每个交叉口单独训练，形成无法跨地点共享证据的模型库。我们提出PhaseShift，一种拓扑感知框架，将异构的路侧轨迹统一为共享的以主体为中心的表示，并训练一个可复用的主干网络。自车相对坐标、轨迹诱导的运动路径、归一化信号灯上下文以及可变基数的交互令牌，在保留行为相关拓扑的同时去除了场地特异性约定。该主干网络支持联合训练、在未见交叉口上的零样本推理以及低数据量的自适应微调。我们在佛罗里达州两个地区的五个交叉口上，基于平衡的现场数据、每个地点10万训练窗口与等规模测试集，在回放条件与最佳采样轨迹协议下进行评估。在10秒预测时，单个联合模型在所有五个地点的minADE和minFDE指标上均优于本地训练模型，中位数降幅分别为36.8%和22.0%。留一交叉口外推部署（包含一个跨区域折）在五分之四的地点于10秒指标上超越本地训练，尽管短时域表现不够一致。使用1000个目标更新窗口进行微调可改善三个地点的零样本性能，并在一个地点成为最优策略。在7号地点，固定10万窗口预算下每种跨地点混合方案均大幅降低长时域误差；测试似然增益否定了仅由最佳采样离散性解释的可能性。在长自回归推演后，高流量最大的两个地点的本地模型落后于标定后的IDM模型，而预训练主干网络模型则不然。在这五地点评估中，PhaseShift展示了在异构物理控制设置下的整合能力，同时识别出仍需适配的场地。该协议衡量的是回放上下文下的条件单车辆生成能力，而非闭环交通仿真。
