Authors: Yash Ranjan, Artur Kumik, Rahul Sengupta, Anand Rangarajan, Sanjay Ranka

CRESSim-Neo: A Batched GPU Simulation Engine for Surgical Robotics and Robot Learning RLRobot

batched GPU simulation surgical robotics position-based simulation zero-copy PyTorch robot learning

简要说明：CRESSim-Neo是一个面向手术机器人的批量化GPU仿真引擎，支持刚体、可变形组织、流体和绳索，通过零拷贝PyTorch集成实现高吞吐并行机器人学习与手术仿真。

TLDR: CRESSim-Neo is a batched GPU simulation engine for surgical robotics that supports rigid bodies, deformable tissues, fluids, and strands with zero-copy PyTorch integration, enabling high-throughput parallel robot learning and surgical simulation.

Abstract: We introduce CRESSim-Neo, a batched GPU simulation engine for surgical robotics and robot learning. CRESSim-Neo combines position-based simulation of rigid bodies, deformable tissues, fluids, and strands with batched rendering, surgery-specific sensing, and a GPU-resident data pipeline. The engine supports applications including tissue manipulation, fluid suction, suturing, cable-driven robots, and ultrasound image synthesis. Direct access to physics and rendering buffers enables GPU-resident robot learning and zero-copy PyTorch integration using DLPack. We demonstrate CRESSim-Neo across rigid-body, deformable-body, and fluid simulation tasks, including vision-based and surgical robot-learning scenarios. On an NVIDIA RTX 4090, the engine achieves up to 2.03 million environment steps per second for 8192 parallel CartPole environments, and scales to batched surgical scenarios involving tissue deformation, fluid interaction, and ultrasound sensing. Overall, CRESSim-Neo provides a unified and scalable platform for surgical simulation, synthetic data generation, and surgical robot learning.

摘要（中文）：摘要：我们介绍了CRESSim-Neo，这是一个面向手术机器人和机器人学习的批处理式GPU仿真引擎。CRESSim-Neo将刚体、可变形组织、流体和绳索的基于位置的仿真与批处理渲染、手术专用感知以及驻留GPU的数据流水线相结合。该引擎支持多种应用，包括组织操作、流体吸引、缝合、线缆驱动机器人以及超声图像合成。通过直接访问物理和渲染缓冲区，实现了驻留GPU的机器人学习以及基于DLPack的零拷贝PyTorch集成。我们在刚体、可变形体及流体仿真任务中展示了CRESSim-Neo的性能，包括基于视觉和手术机器人的学习场景。在NVIDIA RTX 4090上，该引擎针对8192个并行CartPole环境达到了每秒203万个环境步的处理速度，并可扩展到涉及组织变形、流体交互和超声传感的批处理手术场景。总体而言，CRESSim-Neo为手术仿真、合成数据生成及手术机器人学习提供了一个统一且可扩展的平台。

Authors: Yafei Ou, Ahnaf Naheen, Tleukhan Mussin, Hans Jarales, Melwin Moncy, Mahdi Tavakoli

Code World Model: Coding Agent as World Brain WorldModel

code world model world brain coding agent proxy representation video generation

简要说明：本文提出一种框架，利用编码智能体作为世界大脑，通过代码维护持久、规则一致的世界状态，并通过代理表示连接视频生成实现高保真视觉渲染，旨在构建开放世界模型。

TLDR: This paper proposes a framework that uses a coding agent as a world brain to maintain persistent, rule-consistent world state via code, and connects it to video generation via a proxy representation for high-fidelity visual rendering, aiming toward open-ended world models.

Abstract: World models aim to simulate how complex environments evolve under actions and events, yet existing video-based world models primarily learn dynamics from visual observations, which reveal outcomes rather than the underlying knowledge, rules, and mechanisms governing world evolution. This makes it difficult to maintain persistent consequences and support coherent, open-ended evolution. We introduce Code World Model, a framework that separates world evolution from visual realization by combining the reasoning and coding capabilities of language models with the generative priors of video models. A coding agent serves as the world brain, reasoning about events and their consequences and generating executable code to maintain persistent world state and perform rule-consistent evolution. To connect executable state with visual generation, we introduce a proxy representation that encodes frame-wise spatiotemporal constraints and is compiled into a proxy video, which conditions a video model to render high-fidelity visual observations. We further develop data pipelines for constructing aligned proxy-observation pairs from gameplay and real-world videos. After fine-tuning on paired gameplay data, MiniMax-H3 follows proxy-based spatiotemporal specifications from simple interactive worlds built by the coding agent while preserving rich visual details and dynamics. These results demonstrate the potential of combining code for persistent world evolution with video models for flexible visual realization, providing a new path toward open-ended world models.

摘要（中文）：世界模型旨在模拟复杂环境在行动与事件作用下的演化过程，然而现有的基于视频的世界模型主要通过视觉观测来学习动态规律——这些观测呈现的是演化的结果，而非支配世界演化的潜在知识、规则与机制。这导致模型难以维持持续性的因果效应，也无法支持连贯且开放式的演化过程。本文提出代码世界模型框架，通过将语言模型的推理与编码能力同视频模型的生成先验相结合，将世界演化过程与视觉呈现相分离。编码智能体作为世界大脑，对事件及其后果进行推理，并生成可执行代码以维持持久化的世界状态、实现规则一致的演化。为将可执行状态与视觉生成相衔接，我们引入一种代理表征，该表征编码了逐帧时空约束，并编译生成代理视频，进而引导视频模型渲染出高保真的视觉观测。我们进一步开发了数据流水线，用于从游戏过程与真实世界视频中构建对齐的代理-观测配对数据。在配对的游戏数据上经过微调后，MiniMax-H3模型能够遵循编码智能体构建的简单交互世界中的代理时空规范，同时保留丰富的视觉细节与动态。这些结果表明，将代码驱动的持久世界演化与视频模型驱动的灵活视觉呈现相结合具有巨大潜力，为构建开放式世界模型开辟了新路径。

Authors: Yiwen Chen, Guosheng Lin, Chi Zhang

Agentic Game Development as a Verifiable Trajectory Data Engine for Scaling World Models WorldModel

world models game development reinforcement learning verifiable reward spatial generation

简要说明：提出RLHEV，一种利用游戏引擎作为可验证奖励环境的后训练范式，通过密集的引擎信号和人类反馈来扩展世界模型。

TLDR: Proposes RLHEV, a post-training paradigm that leverages game engines as verifiable reward environments for scaling world models through dense engine signals and human feedback.

Abstract: A common strategy for scaling world models is to train on more crawled video with more compute. We argue that this strategy is inefficient: scaling world models also requires a recursive data engine that offers grounded reward signals. The success of code agents illustrates why this matters. As code is executable, compilers and runtimes can provide high-quality rewards for Reinforcement Learning (RL) post-training of LLMs. By contrast, spatial generation still relies largely on fuzzy proxies such as CLIP scores. These signals are fuzzy and biased, making them hard to support RL post-training. Compared with these, game development provides a missing reward environment for spatial world models. A scene encoded by a game engine is an executable world specification: the engine can efficiently check collision, physics, navigability and bounded playability, while the developer provides the global verification signal by judging whether the scene should be accepted. Game development also provides real-world long-horizon trajectory data for RL post-training. We therefore propose Reinforcement Learning with Human-Engine Verification (RLHEV), a post-training paradigm that combines dense engine signals with implicit human acceptance feedback from the development process.

摘要（中文）：一种常见的扩展世界模型策略是利用更多算力训练更多的网络爬取视频。我们认为这种策略效率低下：扩展世界模型还需要一个能够提供基础奖励信号的递归数据引擎。代码智能体的成功正说明了这一点的重要性。由于代码是可执行的，编译器和运行时可以为大语言模型的强化学习后训练提供高质量奖励。相比之下，空间生成仍然主要依赖CLIP评分等模糊代理指标。这些信号既模糊又存在偏差，难以支撑强化学习后训练。与之相比，游戏开发为空间世界模型提供了缺失的奖励环境。由游戏引擎编码的场景是一种可执行的世界规范：引擎能够高效检测碰撞、物理规则、可导航性和有限可玩性，而开发者则通过判断场景是否应该被接受来提供全局验证信号。游戏开发还为强化学习后训练提供了现实世界中的长程轨迹数据。因此，我们提出人机引擎协同验证的强化学习范式，这是一种将密集引擎信号与开发过程中隐含的人类接受反馈相结合的后训练范式。

Authors: Pengfei Zhou, Hexin Wang, Zhengfeiyang Zhang, Yixing Ma, Zhenglin Wan, Kaipeng Zhang, Wangbo Zhao, Yang You

4DStreamCtrl: Interactive Video Generation with Online 4D Control WorldModel

4D control streaming video generation 3D point-track representation causal diffusion model interactive world models

简要说明：本文提出4DStreamCtrl，通过统一的3D点轨迹表示实现相机和物体的联合控制，支持实时流式视频生成，并指出该工作朝着交互式世界模型和具身智能体闭环控制迈进。

TLDR: This paper introduces 4DStreamCtrl, a unified 3D point-track representation for joint camera and object control in video generation, enabling real-time, streaming generation with 3D consistency, and positions the work as a step toward interactive world models for embodied agents.

Abstract: Generative video models now synthesize footage nearly indistinguishable from reality. Their promise as interactive tools hinges on fine-grained control of how objects and the camera move over time, yet each existing approach captures only part of this: camera-parameter methods steer the viewpoint but cannot move objects, 2D-trajectory methods act in the image plane and ignore depth and occlusion, and recent 3D methods add geometry but run only offline at a fixed length. In particular, none combines 3D-consistent control of both camera and objects with real-time, streaming generation. Here we show that camera motion, object trajectories, and depth can be unified into a single 3D point-track representation, from which one model performs joint camera and object control, depth editing, and motion transfer in a single forward pass. To learn this interface at scale, we mine in-the-wild video for 3D motion supervision, yielding OpenVidHD-Motion3D, and encode it with a lightweight Geometric Motion Head that plugs into a pretrained video diffusion model. Because this encoder is temporally separable, we distill the model into a causal streaming student that generates arbitrarily long video in four denoising steps at memory independent of length. This unified design surpasses prior camera-only, 2D, and offline-3D methods in motion-control precision while covering modalities they address only in isolation. 4DStreamCtrl runs at 20 FPS on a single high-end GPU for 480p video and stays temporally coherent over hundreds of frames, enabling, to our knowledge, interactive 4D-controllable streaming generation for the first time. More broadly, grounding generation in explicit 3D geometry with efficient causal inference points toward interactive world models with closed-loop spatiotemporal control, from controllable simulators to real-time visual imagination for embodied agents.

摘要（中文）：生成式视频模型现已能合成几可乱真的影像。其作为交互工具的潜力取决于对物体与相机随时间运动的精细控制，然而现有方法各自仅实现部分功能：相机参数方法可操控视角却无法移动物体，二维轨迹方法作用于图像平面而忽略深度与遮挡，近期三维方法虽引入几何结构却仅能离线生成固定长度的视频。尤为关键的是，尚无方法能在实时流式生成中同时实现相机与物体的三维一致性控制。本文证明，相机运动、物体轨迹与深度可统一为单一的三维点轨迹表征，基于该表征的单个模型可在一个前向过程中完成相机与物体的联合控制、深度编辑及运动迁移。为规模化学习该接口，我们从自然视频中挖掘三维运动监督信号，构建OpenVidHD-Motion3D数据集，并通过轻量级几何运动头进行编码，嵌入预训练视频扩散模型。由于该编码器具有时序可分离特性，我们将其蒸馏为因果流式学生模型，可在四个去噪步骤中生成长度任意的视频，且内存消耗与时长无关。这一统一设计在运动控制精度上超越此前仅支持相机控制、二维控制或离线三维控制的方法，同时完整覆盖这些方法仅能孤立处理的模态。4DStreamCtrl在单块高端GPU上以20FPS速率生成480p视频，并在数百帧范围内保持时序一致性，据我们所知，首次实现了交互式四维可控流式生成。更广泛而言，将生成过程植根于显式三维几何并结合高效因果推理，为具身智能体从可控模拟器到实时视觉想象等应用指明了通向具备闭环时空控制能力的交互式世界模型的道路。

Authors: Shiqian Li, Chenguo Lin, Zhiguang Liu, Yu Tang, Jiarong Ou, Rui Chen, Yixin Zhu

4DGS-WAM: Bridging Past and Future with an Object-Centric World Action Model based on 4D Gaussian Splatting WorldModel

4D Gaussian Splatting world action model object-centric future prediction autonomous driving

简要说明：提出一种基于4D高斯泼溅的以对象为中心的世界动作模型，分别建模动态物体和静态背景，预测未来状态时无需重新生成静态内容。

TLDR: Proposes an object-centric world action model using 4D Gaussian Splatting to separately model dynamic objects and static background, enabling future-state prediction without regenerating static content.

Abstract: Current world action models (WAMs) typically operate on 2D visual data. These models can achieve exceptional visual quality, but they lack explicit spatial structure for individual objects and repeatedly process redundant background content. Although point clouds can represent the world in 3D space, they can be difficult to align and accumulate across viewpoints. In this paper, we leverage an explicit 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) representation that separately models dynamic objects and the static background of a scene. For dynamic objects, we use a policy model to predict future actor actions and a world model to predict transformations of their observed Gaussian splats. The static background need not be regenerated for future states, as much of it has already been observed in past frames. This forms an object-centric world action model, which we name 4DGS-WAM. It lifts 2D observations into a persistent 4D representation so that previously observed static content can be reused during future prediction. Future-state extrapolation can then focus on modeling the evolution of dynamic objects. Experiments on KITTI-MOT evaluate short-horizon prediction and past reconstruction.

摘要（中文）：当前世界行动模型通常基于二维视觉数据运行。这类模型虽能实现卓越的视觉质量，但缺乏针对独立物体的显式空间结构，且会反复处理冗余的背景内容。尽管点云能以三维空间形式表征世界，但不同视角间的点云难以对齐与累积。本文采用显式四维高斯泼溅表征，将场景中的动态物体与静态背景分别建模。针对动态物体，我们使用策略模型预测未来主体动作，并通过世界模型预测其所观测高斯泼溅的变换。静态背景无需为未来状态重新生成，因其大部分内容已在过往帧中完成观测。由此构建以物体为中心的世界行动模型，命名为4DGS-WAM。该模型将二维观测提升为持久化四维表征，使得先前观测到的静态内容可在未来预测中重复使用。未来状态外推可聚焦于动态物体的演化建模。在KITTI-MOT数据集上的实验评估了短时域预测性能与历史重建效果。

Low-Resolution Perception for Robotic Packing Perception3D

low-resolution depth sensing next-best-view robotic packing reconstruction cues grasp evidence

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于机器人打包的框架，利用低分辨率深度感知，通过重建驱动的下一最佳视角选择和抓取证据驱动的稳定性估计，减少冗余视角，实现可扩展的感知。

TLDR: This paper proposes a framework for robotic packing that uses low-resolution depth sensing, combining reconstruction-driven next-best-view selection with grasp-evidence-based stability estimation to reduce redundant views and enable scalable perception.

Abstract: This work tackles the problem of scalable perception for robotic packing with low-cost, low-resolution depth sensing. We propose a framework where reconstruction cues drive next-view selection and grasp evidence updates a per-object stability estimate, jointly deciding what to acquire next and when to grasp. During the reconstruction, a low-resolution Next Best View (NBV) strategy explicitly avoids redundant views while preserving task-relevant geometry. We validate the approach in two steps: (i) an ablation study of the utility function under very low resolution, and (ii) a full end-to-end evaluation across policies, showing how low-resolution perception is a practical, scalable option for robotic packing.

摘要（中文）：本工作针对低成本、低分辨率深度感知下的机器人打包可扩展感知问题展开研究。我们提出一个框架，其中重建线索驱动下一视角选择，抓取证据更新每个物体的稳定性估计，共同决策下一步应采集何种信息及何时执行抓取。在重建过程中，低分辨率下的最优下一视角（NBV）策略在保留任务相关几何特征的同时，明确避免冗余视角。我们通过两个步骤验证该方法：（i）在极低分辨率下对效用函数进行消融研究，以及（ii）跨策略的全端到端评估，证明低分辨率感知是机器人打包中一种实用且可扩展的方案。

Authors: Giuseppe Fabio Preziosa, Federico Vignoni, Chiara Castellano, Marco Faroni, Andrea Maria Zanchettin, Paolo Rocco

Anytime Global Tensor Motion Planning Manipulation

global tensor motion planning anytime algorithm homotopy class local planner manipulation

简要说明：本文扩展了全局张量运动规划（GTMP），提出了具有理论保证的任意时间算法，在操作和二维导航基准上验证了性能。

TLDR: This paper extends Global Tensor Motion Planning (GTMP) with anytime algorithms and theoretical guarantees for homotopy class coverage, demonstrating performance on manipulation and 2D navigation benchmarks.

Abstract: Global Tensor Motion Planning (GTMP) solves motion planning with batched tensor operations over a layered multipartite graph. We generalize GTMP so that adjacent-layer edges are realized by any black-box local planner (e.g., linear interpolation, splines, sampling-based planning, trajectory optimization, or generative sampling). We provide two anytime policies on top of this generalization: Anytime GTMP with random restarts at a fixed budget, which covers every homotopy class almost surely, and AO-GTMP with informed expansion with growing budgets, which converges to the optimal cost. We prove that a single sampled graph covers every endpoint-fixed homotopy class admitting a \(δ\)-clear representative of bounded length. We also prove that additional samples per layer reduce the per-layer miss probability exponentially, whereas stronger local planners reduce the required layer count only sublinearly. On manipulation benchmarks the method matches state-of-the-art performance, and on 2D navigation it returns batches of topologically diverse solutions, while the informed baselines concentrate on one or two classes.

摘要（中文）：全局张量运动规划（GTMP）通过在分层多部图上执行批量张量运算来解决运动规划问题。我们对GTMP进行泛化，使得相邻层之间的边可由任意黑盒局部规划器（例如线性插值、样条曲线、基于采样的规划、轨迹优化或生成式采样）实现。在此泛化基础上，我们提供了两种任意时间策略：固定预算下带随机重启的任意时间GTMP，其能以几乎必然的方式覆盖所有同伦类；以及预算递增下带信息扩展的AO-GTMP，其可收敛至最优代价。我们证明：单次采样图即可覆盖所有端点固定的、存在有界长度δ-清晰代表元的同伦类。我们还证明：每层额外采样可使逐层缺失概率呈指数级下降，而更强的局部规划器仅能亚线性地减少所需层数。在操作类基准测试中，该方法达到了与当前最优方法相当的性能；在二维导航任务中，它能返回一批拓扑多样化的解，而基于信息扩展的基线方法则集中于一个或两个同伦类。

Abstract: This work proposes a Deep Learning Enhanced PVT algorithm to mitigate multipath interference in dense urban areas. A supervised objective jointly predicts range corrections and uncertainty, while a JEPA-based self-supervised pretraining stage improves representation quality. The algorithm is evaluated over diverse driving scenarios, substantially improving PVT accuracy, particularly for unseen harsh urban conditions. These results highlight the potential of unlabelled GNSS data to improve generalization performance.

Authors: Thomas Barbero, Bertrand Ekambi

Advantage-Driven Explicit Memory for Social Navigation RLRobot

social navigation explicit memory advantage-driven non-parametric memory sim-to-real

简要说明：提出一种社交导航智能体，利用优势信号索引的非参数显式记忆存储关键历史事件，从而增强泛化能力并处理罕见故障（如碰撞）。

TLDR: A social navigation agent uses non-parametric explicit memory indexed by advantage signals to store critical past events, enabling better generalization and handling of rare failures like collisions.

Abstract: Robot policies are predominantly learned with classical parametric variants of imitation learning or RL, where training stores the agent's behavior exclusively in the policy's network parameters, putting a heavy burden on the representation learning algorithm. We propose a new navigation agent equipped with non-parametric memory which explicitly indexes prior steps leading to critical events. The advantages are twofold: first, it allows the policy to outsource some of its behavior into an explicit memory; second, it encourages a form of continual learning by allowing an agent to collect data from its testing episodes during deployment and therefore to better generalize to OOD situations. In the context of social navigation, we show that this improves the agent's capability to retain sparse, high-cost failures, such as human collisions. If the policy is trained in simulation, this also naturally addresses the sim-to-real gap, partially, by basing some of the decision making on real data. We integrate the explicit memory into a recurrent PPO architecture and use hidden states for memory retrieval to capture continuous spatiotemporal dynamics. The goal of exploiting rare, high-impact events is achieved by leveraging the RL agent's advantage signals. We train our agent in simulation with a combination of photorealistic rendering and non-visual crowd simulation and show that the agent is robust with respect to OOD social behavior.

摘要（中文）：机器人策略主要通过模仿学习或强化学习的经典参数化变体进行训练，该方式将智能体的行为完全存储于策略的网络参数中，从而对表示学习算法施加了沉重负担。我们提出了一种配备非参数记忆的新型导航智能体，该记忆能够显式索引导致关键事件的先前步骤。其优势体现在两方面：第一，允许策略将部分行为外包至显式记忆；第二，通过使智能体在部署期间从测试片段中收集数据并因此更好地泛化至分布外场景，从而促进持续学习形式。在社会导航情境下，我们证明该方法提升了智能体保留稀疏高成本失败案例（如与行人碰撞）的能力。若策略在模拟环境中训练，通过将部分决策建立于真实数据之上，该方法亦能自然弥合仿真与现实的差距。我们将显式记忆集成至循环PPO架构中，并利用隐藏状态进行记忆检索以捕捉连续时空动态。通过利用强化学习智能体的优势信号，最终实现了对稀有高影响事件的利用目标。我们在仿真环境中结合照片级渲染与非视觉人群模拟对智能体进行训练，结果表明该智能体对分布外社会行为具有鲁棒性。

Longitudinal Robot Learning from Demonstration with Care Providers in a Home Environment RLRobot

Learning from demonstration non-expert end users care providers home environment assistive tasks

简要说明：本文在家庭环境中评估了非专家护理人员通过示范学习（LfD）教授机器人技能的效果，识别了关键障碍，并通过预训练和自适应反馈支持教学，最终开源了相关数据集。

TLDR: This paper evaluates Learning from Demonstration (LfD) methods with non-expert care providers in home environments over multiple visits, identifying key barriers and providing pre-training and adaptive feedback to support teaching without live expert feedback, and open-sourcing the resulting dataset.

Abstract: Learning from demonstration (LfD) methods enable non-expert end users to teach robots novel skills without explicit programming. However most evaluations of the usability of LfD with non-experts has been conducted in controlled laboratory environments with a robotics experimenter present. In this work we identify non-expert end users' key barriers when teaching robots via demonstration without live robotics expert feedback in a home environment. In our human subjects experiment we support the non-expert end users through two forms of demonstrator guidance developed in prior work: pre-training and adaptive feedback. Towards the ecological validity of the evaluation, we conduct this experimentation over multiple visits, with a population of care providers. Finally, we propose to open source the resulting LfD dataset of care providers teaching a robot assistive tasks over multiple visits to a home environment.

摘要（中文）：基于演示的学习（LfD）方法使非专业终端用户无需显式编程即可教会机器人新技能。然而，目前对非专业用户使用LfD的可用性评估大多在有机器人实验人员在场的受控实验室环境中进行。在本研究中，我们识别出非专业终端用户在家庭环境中（无机器人专家实时反馈）通过演示教学机器人时面临的主要障碍。在人体受试者实验中，我们通过先前工作开发的两种演示者引导形式（预训练与自适应反馈）为非专业终端用户提供支持。为提升评估的生态效度，我们对一组护理人员进行了多轮访问实验。最后，我们提议将护理人员在多轮家庭环境访问中教授机器人辅助任务所产生的LfD数据集开源。

Authors: Nina Moorman, Julianna Schalkwyk, Vriksha Srihari, Qingyu Xiao, Kamel Alrashedy, Hongseok Jeong, Kiersten Lange, Matthew B. Luebbers, Matthew Gombolay

Rollout-Decoded Reconstruction for Long-Horizon Prediction in Latent World Models WorldModel

latent world model rollout-decoded reconstruction long-horizon prediction free-running rollout chaotic dynamics

简要说明：一种用于潜在世界模型的单一损失项，通过解码自由运行的展开潜在变量来惩罚重建误差，从而弥合训练与评估之间的差距，改善了混沌动力学上的长时域预测。

TLDR: A single loss term for latent world models that bridges the training-evaluation gap by decoding free-running rollout latents to penalize reconstruction error, improving long-horizon prediction on chaotic dynamics.

Abstract: A latent world model trains its decoder on latents anchored to observations, then deploys it on the model's own free-running rollout, hundreds of steps past the last observation. Rollout-Decoded Reconstruction (RDR) closes this gap with a single loss term that free-runs the model during training exactly as evaluation will, decodes every rollout latent, and penalizes reconstruction error against ground truth. The term adds no parameters, costs training-time compute only, and reduces to the standard objective at weight zero, so every comparison in this paper is a one-flag A/B. On the chaotic Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation, RDR raises valid prediction time (the time to first crossing of normalized error 0.5) from $3.87 \pm 0.23$ to $6.97 \pm 0.42$ time units at an identical 193,568 parameters, a $1.80\times$ improvement confirmed on seeds never used in selection and holding in 10 of 10 preregistered configurations at ratios of 1.71-2.50$\times$. The results come from a single system; a sweep in which the advantage grows with latent width is descriptive, and control experiments on two classic tasks are preliminary.

摘要（中文）：一个潜变量世界模型在训练阶段使用锚定于观测数据的潜变量来训练其解码器，随后在模型自主生成的、距最后观测数据数百步长的自由运行轨迹上部署该解码器。滚动解码重建（RDR）通过单一损失项弥合了这一差距——该损失项在训练期间如同评估阶段般使模型自由运行，解码每个滚动步长的潜变量，并根据真实数据惩罚重建误差。该损失项不增加参数量，仅消耗训练阶段计算资源，且当权重为零时退化为标准目标函数，因此本文所有比较均采用单一变量的A/B测试。在混沌的Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程上，RDR在保持193,568个参数完全相同的情况下，将有效预测时间（归一化误差首次达到0.5的时间）从3.87±0.23个时间单位提升至6.97±0.42个时间单位，实现了1.80倍的性能提升——该结果在未参与参数选择的随机种子和10组预注册配置中均得到验证，提升倍数范围为1.71至2.50倍。上述结果来自单一系统；描述性实验表明该优势随潜变量宽度扩大而增强，同时两个经典任务的控制实验仅为初步验证。
